# sui

> A Vue 3 component registry in the shadcn style: you download the source with `bunx shadcn-vue@latest add http://localhost:5173/r/<name>.json` and own it. One distinct identity, themed only through tokens. Built on Reka UI, Tailwind v4 and TypeScript.

Identity (not options): a raised face sits on a darker 2px "slab"; 1px edges; soft tinted tones; stripes mean "still to do"; a dashed edge means disabled or busy; one control height; three font weights; mono for labels and figures. Components take no style variants. Theme the whole system with four tokens in sui-theme.css (brand colour, radius, slab depth, font); scheme (`data-scheme="dark|auto"`) and contrast (`data-contrast="high|auto"`) are attributes on <html>.

Setup: install Tailwind v4, add the `@` alias, add a components.json, then `@import "./styles/sui-theme.css"` after Tailwind. Steps: http://localhost:5173/#/start


---

# Button

Primary action: a face on a slab that sinks onto it when pressed, with a busy state and icon slots.

Group: Primitives. Registry item: http://localhost:5173/r/button.json

## Install

```sh
bunx shadcn-vue@latest add http://localhost:5173/r/button.json
```

Installs with: theme, utils. npm packages: reka-ui.

Import it from your own copy: `import Button from '@/components/ui/button.vue'`.

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `loading` | `boolean` |  | Busy: a spinner sits over the label, the width does not change and clicks are ignored. |
| `block` | `boolean` |  | Stretch to the full width of the parent. |

Also takes everything in PrimitiveProps, and `class` for placement only.

Slots: `default`.

## Usage

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { h, ref } from 'vue'
import Button from '@/components/ui/button.vue'

// Each button owns its busy flag, so pressing one never makes another busy.
const busy = ref({ save: false, download: false })
function run(key: 'save' | 'download') {
  busy.value[key] = true
  setTimeout(() => (busy.value[key] = false), 1800)
}
const stroke = { viewBox: '0 0 16 16', fill: 'none', stroke: 'currentColor', 'stroke-width': 1.75, 'stroke-linecap': 'round', 'stroke-linejoin': 'round' } as const
const Plus = () => h('svg', stroke, [h('path', { d: 'M8 3v10M3 8h10' })])
const Download = () => h('svg', stroke, [h('path', { d: 'M8 2v8M4.5 7 8 10.5 11.5 7M3 13h10' })])
</script>

<template>
  <div class="grid gap-8">
    <div class="flex flex-col gap-2">
      <p class="kicker">Default and disabled</p>
      <div class="flex flex-wrap gap-3">
        <Button>Save changes</Button>
        <Button disabled>Disabled</Button>
        <Button as="a" href="#/start">As a link</Button>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="flex flex-col gap-2">
      <p class="kicker">With an icon: it is just a child</p>
      <div class="flex flex-wrap gap-3">
        <Button><Plus /> New project</Button>
        <Button><Download /> Download</Button>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="flex flex-col gap-2">
      <p class="kicker">Busy: press one. The width holds and clicks are ignored</p>
      <div class="flex flex-wrap gap-3">
        <Button :loading="busy.save" @click="run('save')">Save</Button>
        <Button :loading="busy.download" @click="run('download')"><Download /> Download</Button>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="flex max-w-sm flex-col gap-2">
      <p class="kicker">Full width</p>
      <Button block>Create your account</Button>
    </div>
  </div>
</template>
```

## Rules

- Style it through theme tokens, not classes: sui has one design per component and no variants. `tone` exists only on status components.
- You own the copy: edit the file if the design must change.


---

# Icon button

Square button for an icon alone: a required label, a tooltip, a busy state and a 44px tap size.

Group: Primitives. Registry item: http://localhost:5173/r/icon-button.json

## Install

```sh
bunx shadcn-vue@latest add http://localhost:5173/r/icon-button.json
```

Installs with: theme, utils, tooltip. npm packages: reka-ui.

Import it from your own copy: `import Iconbutton from '@/components/ui/icon-button.vue'`.

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `label (required)` | `string` |  | The accessible name. Required: an icon alone says nothing to a screen reader. It also shows as a tooltip. |
| `loading` | `boolean` |  |  |
| `tooltip` | `boolean` | `true` | Show the label as a tooltip. Turn it off when the button is the `as-child` trigger of a menu or dialog (a tooltip wrapper has no element of its own to hand back); the `title` attribute then carries the label. |

Also takes everything in PrimitiveProps, and `class` for placement only.

Slots: `default`.

## Usage

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref } from 'vue'
import IconButton from '@/components/ui/icon-button.vue'
import DropdownMenu from '@/components/ui/dropdown-menu.vue'

const busy = ref(false)
function refresh() {
  busy.value = true
  setTimeout(() => (busy.value = false), 1600)
}
const stroke = { fill: 'none', stroke: 'currentColor', 'stroke-width': 1.75, 'stroke-linecap': 'round', 'stroke-linejoin': 'round' } as const
</script>

<template>
  <div class="grid gap-8">
    <div class="flex flex-col gap-2">
      <p class="kicker">Hover or focus for the label</p>
      <div class="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3">
        <IconButton label="Add"><svg viewBox="0 0 16 16" v-bind="stroke"><path d="M8 3v10M3 8h10" /></svg></IconButton>
        <IconButton label="Search"><svg viewBox="0 0 16 16" v-bind="stroke"><circle cx="7" cy="7" r="4.5" /><path d="M10.5 10.5L14 14" /></svg></IconButton>
        <IconButton label="Settings"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" v-bind="stroke"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="3" /><path d="M12 3v3M12 18v3M3 12h3M18 12h3M5.6 5.6l2.1 2.1M16.3 16.3l2.1 2.1M18.4 5.6l-2.1 2.1M7.7 16.3l-2.1 2.1" /></svg></IconButton>
        <IconButton label="Unavailable" disabled><svg viewBox="0 0 16 16" v-bind="stroke"><path d="M3 8h10" /></svg></IconButton>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="flex flex-col gap-2">
      <p class="kicker">Busy: press refresh</p>
      <div><IconButton label="Refresh" :loading="busy" @click="refresh"><svg viewBox="0 0 16 16" v-bind="stroke"><path d="M13 8a5 5 0 1 1-1.5-3.5M13 2.5V5h-2.5" /></svg></IconButton></div>
    </div>
    <div class="flex flex-col gap-2">
      <p class="kicker">As a menu trigger, with the tooltip off</p>
      <DropdownMenu :items="[{ value: 'rename', label: 'Rename' }, { value: 'duplicate', label: 'Duplicate' }, { value: 'delete', label: 'Delete' }]">
        <template #trigger>
          <IconButton label="More actions" :tooltip="false"><svg viewBox="0 0 16 16" fill="currentColor"><circle cx="3.5" cy="8" r="1.4" /><circle cx="8" cy="8" r="1.4" /><circle cx="12.5" cy="8" r="1.4" /></svg></IconButton>
        </template>
      </DropdownMenu>
    </div>
  </div>
</template>
```

## Rules

- Style it through theme tokens, not classes: sui has one design per component and no variants. `tone` exists only on status components.
- You own the copy: edit the file if the design must change.

# Badge

Stamp for status: a tinted chip with a tone-coloured side slab.

Group: Primitives. Registry item: http://localhost:5173/r/badge.json

## Install

```sh
bunx shadcn-vue@latest add http://localhost:5173/r/badge.json
```

Installs with: theme, utils. npm packages: none beyond Vue.

Import it from your own copy: `import Badge from '@/components/ui/badge.vue'`.

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `tone` | `'neutral' \| 'info' \| 'success' \| 'warning' \| 'danger'` | `'neutral'` |  |

Slots: `default`.

## Usage

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import Badge from '@/components/ui/badge.vue'
</script>

<template>
  <div class="grid gap-8">
    <div class="flex flex-col gap-2">
      <p class="kicker">Tones</p>
      <div class="flex flex-wrap gap-3">
        <Badge>Draft</Badge>
        <Badge tone="info">New</Badge>
        <Badge tone="success">Paid</Badge>
        <Badge tone="warning">Due soon</Badge>
        <Badge tone="danger">Overdue</Badge>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="flex max-w-sm flex-col gap-2">
      <p class="kicker">In context</p>
      <div class="flex items-center justify-between border-b border-edge py-3"><span>Invoice 1042</span><Badge tone="success">Paid</Badge></div>
      <div class="flex items-center justify-between border-b border-edge py-3"><span>Invoice 1043</span><Badge tone="warning">Due soon</Badge></div>
      <div class="flex items-center justify-between py-3"><span>Invoice 1044</span><Badge tone="danger">Overdue</Badge></div>
    </div>
  </div>
</template>
```

## Rules

- Style it through theme tokens, not classes: sui has one design per component and no variants. `tone` exists only on status components.
- You own the copy: edit the file if the design must change.

# Button group

Buttons joined into one control with matching corners.

Group: Primitives. Registry item: http://localhost:5173/r/button-group.json

## Install

```sh
bunx shadcn-vue@latest add http://localhost:5173/r/button-group.json
```

Installs with: theme, utils. npm packages: none beyond Vue.

Import it from your own copy: `import Buttongroup from '@/components/ui/button-group.vue'`.

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `orientation` | `'horizontal' \| 'vertical'` | `'horizontal'` |  |

Slots: `default`.

## Usage

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import Button from '@/components/ui/button.vue'
import ButtonGroup from '@/components/ui/button-group.vue'
</script>

<template>
  <div class="flex flex-wrap items-start gap-x-12 gap-y-8">
    <div class="flex flex-col gap-2">
      <p class="kicker">Horizontal</p>
      <ButtonGroup>
        <Button>Day</Button>
        <Button>Week</Button>
        <Button disabled>Month</Button>
      </ButtonGroup>
    </div>
    <div class="flex flex-col gap-2">
      <p class="kicker">Vertical</p>
      <ButtonGroup orientation="vertical">
        <Button>Top</Button>
        <Button>Middle</Button>
        <Button>Bottom</Button>
      </ButtonGroup>
    </div>
  </div>
</template>
```

## Rules

- Style it through theme tokens, not classes: sui has one design per component and no variants. `tone` exists only on status components.
- You own the copy: edit the file if the design must change.

| --- | --- | --- | --- |

# Card

Framed surface that groups related content.

Group: Primitives. Registry item: http://localhost:5173/r/card.json

## Install

```sh
bunx shadcn-vue@latest add http://localhost:5173/r/card.json
```

Installs with: theme, utils. npm packages: none beyond Vue.

Import it from your own copy: `import Card from '@/components/ui/card.vue'`.

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `title` | `string` |  |  |
| `level` | `2 \| 3 \| 4` | `2` |  |

Slots: `default`.

## Usage

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref } from 'vue'
import Button from '@/components/ui/button.vue'
import Card from '@/components/ui/card.vue'
import TextField from '@/components/ui/text-field.vue'

const email = ref('')
</script>

<template>
  <div class="grid items-start gap-6 md:grid-cols-2">
    <div class="flex flex-col gap-2">
      <p class="kicker">With a title</p>
      <Card title="Join the waitlist">
        <TextField v-model="email" label="Email" type="email" placeholder="you@example.com" />
        <div><Button>Notify me</Button></div>
      </Card>
    </div>
    <div class="flex flex-col gap-2">
      <p class="kicker">Without a title</p>
      <Card>
        <p class="font-medium">Plain surface</p>
        <p class="text-muted">Leave the title out and the header goes away; the body keeps its padding and edge.</p>
      </Card>
    </div>
  </div>
</template>
```

## Rules

- Style it through theme tokens, not classes: sui has one design per component and no variants. `tone` exists only on status components.
- You own the copy: edit the file if the design must change.

# Avatar

Image with an initials fallback.

Group: Primitives. Registry item: http://localhost:5173/r/avatar.json

## Install

```sh
bunx shadcn-vue@latest add http://localhost:5173/r/avatar.json
```

Installs with: theme, utils. npm packages: reka-ui.

Import it from your own copy: `import Avatar from '@/components/ui/avatar.vue'`.

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `src` | `string` |  |  |
| `alt` | `string` |  |  |
| `fallback (required)` | `string` |  |  |

## Usage

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import Avatar from '@/components/ui/avatar.vue'
import Badge from '@/components/ui/badge.vue'
</script>

<template>
  <div class="grid gap-8">
    <div class="flex flex-col gap-2">
      <p class="kicker">Initials, and an image that fails to load</p>
      <div class="flex flex-wrap gap-3">
        <Avatar fallback="DG" />
        <Avatar fallback="AB" />
        <Avatar src="/missing.png" alt="" fallback="KL" />
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="flex max-w-sm flex-col gap-2">
      <p class="kicker">In context</p>
      <div v-for="p in [{ i: 'AL', n: 'Ada Lovelace', t: 'Maintainer' }, { i: 'GH', n: 'Grace Hopper', t: 'Reviewer' }]" :key="p.i" class="flex items-center gap-3 border-b border-edge py-3 last:border-b-0">
        <Avatar :fallback="p.i" />
        <div class="grid min-w-0 flex-1 leading-snug"><span class="font-medium">{{ p.n }}</span><span class="text-sm text-muted">{{ p.t }}</span></div>
        <Badge tone="success">Active</Badge>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</template>
```

## Rules

- Style it through theme tokens, not classes: sui has one design per component and no variants. `tone` exists only on status components.
- You own the copy: edit the file if the design must change.

# Spinner

Loading ring: an arc travelling round a dashed track, announced to screen readers.

Group: Primitives. Registry item: http://localhost:5173/r/spinner.json

## Install

```sh
bunx shadcn-vue@latest add http://localhost:5173/r/spinner.json
```

Installs with: theme, utils, announce. npm packages: none beyond Vue.

Import it from your own copy: `import Spinner from '@/components/ui/spinner.vue'`.

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `label` | `string` |  |  |
| `announce` | `boolean` |  |  |

## Usage

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import Card from '@/components/ui/card.vue'
import Spinner from '@/components/ui/spinner.vue'
</script>

<template>
  <div class="grid items-start gap-8 md:grid-cols-2">
    <div class="flex flex-col gap-3">
      <p class="kicker">Bare and labelled</p>
      <Spinner :announce="false" />
      <Spinner label="Loading your results…" :announce="false" />
    </div>
    <div class="flex flex-col gap-2">
      <p class="kicker">In context</p>
      <Card title="Recent activity">
        <div class="grid place-items-center py-6"><Spinner label="Fetching activity…" :announce="false" /></div>
      </Card>
    </div>
    <p class="text-muted md:col-span-2">A spinner that appears is spoken once to screen readers. Pass <code class="numeral">:announce="false"</code> where it would repeat.</p>
  </div>
</template>
```

## Rules

- Style it through theme tokens, not classes: sui has one design per component and no variants. `tone` exists only on status components.
- You own the copy: edit the file if the design must change.

# Progress

Progress bar with a striped track for what is left, a sliding bar when unknown, and spoken value text.

Group: Primitives. Registry item: http://localhost:5173/r/progress.json

## Install

```sh
bunx shadcn-vue@latest add http://localhost:5173/r/progress.json
```

Installs with: theme, utils. npm packages: reka-ui.

Import it from your own copy: `import Progress from '@/components/ui/progress.vue'`.

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `v-model` | `number \| null` | `null` | Two-way bound value. |
| `label` | `string` |  |  |
| `hideLabel` | `boolean` |  |  |
| `hideValue` | `boolean` |  |  |
| `valueText` | `string` |  | What a screen reader hears instead of the percentage, e.g. "3 of 8 files". |

## Usage

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref } from 'vue'
import Button from '@/components/ui/button.vue'
import Progress from '@/components/ui/progress.vue'

const upload = ref(40)
</script>

<template>
  <div class="grid max-w-md gap-8">
    <div class="flex flex-col gap-3">
      <p class="kicker">Determinate: step it</p>
      <Progress v-model="upload" label="Uploading photos" />
      <div class="flex gap-2">
        <Button @click="upload = Math.max(0, upload - 10)">−10</Button>
        <Button @click="upload = Math.min(100, upload + 10)">+10</Button>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="flex flex-col gap-3">
      <p class="kicker">Complete, and unknown length</p>
      <Progress :model-value="100" label="Finished" />
      <Progress label="Waiting for the server" />
    </div>
    <div class="flex flex-col gap-3">
      <p class="kicker">Spoken text instead of a percentage</p>
      <Progress :model-value="38" label="Importing contacts" value-text="3 of 8 files" />
    </div>
  </div>
</template>
```

## Rules

- Style it through theme tokens, not classes: sui has one design per component and no variants. `tone` exists only on status components.
- You own the copy: edit the file if the design must change.


---

# Notice

Inline message with a tone icon and a side slab.

Group: Primitives. Registry item: http://localhost:5173/r/notice.json

## Install

```sh
bunx shadcn-vue@latest add http://localhost:5173/r/notice.json
```

Installs with: theme, utils. npm packages: none beyond Vue.

Import it from your own copy: `import Notice from '@/components/ui/notice.vue'`.

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `tone` | `'neutral' \| 'info' \| 'success' \| 'warning' \| 'danger'` | `'info'` |  |
| `title (required)` | `string` |  |  |

Slots: `default`.

## Usage

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import Button from '@/components/ui/button.vue'
import Notice from '@/components/ui/notice.vue'
</script>

<template>
  <div class="grid max-w-xl gap-8">
    <div class="flex flex-col gap-3">
      <p class="kicker">Tones</p>
      <Notice title="Heads up">Your trial ends in 3 days. Add a payment method to keep your projects.</Notice>
      <Notice tone="success" title="Payment received">A receipt is on its way to your inbox.</Notice>
      <Notice tone="warning" title="Almost out of space">You have used 92% of your storage.</Notice>
      <Notice tone="danger" title="Couldn't save your changes">Check your connection and try again.</Notice>
      <Notice tone="neutral" title="Scheduled maintenance" />
    </div>
    <div class="flex flex-col gap-3">
      <p class="kicker">With an action</p>
      <Notice tone="warning" title="Your plan changes next month">
        <div class="grid items-start gap-3">
          <p>We'll move you to the new pricing automatically. Nothing changes until then.</p>
          <div><Button>Review billing</Button></div>
        </div>
      </Notice>
    </div>
  </div>
</template>
```

## Rules

- Style it through theme tokens, not classes: sui has one design per component and no variants. `tone` exists only on status components.
- You own the copy: edit the file if the design must change.

# Text field

Labelled input with an accessible error message.

Group: Forms. Registry item: http://localhost:5173/r/text-field.json

## Install

```sh
bunx shadcn-vue@latest add http://localhost:5173/r/text-field.json
```

Installs with: theme, utils, field. npm packages: none beyond Vue.

Import it from your own copy: `import Textfield from '@/components/ui/text-field.vue'`.

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `v-model` | `string` | `''` | Two-way bound value. |
| `label (required)` | `string` |  |  |
| `hint` | `string` |  |  |
| `error` | `string` |  |  |
| `required` | `boolean` |  |  |
| `optional` | `boolean` |  |  |
| `hideLabel` | `boolean` |  |  |
| `readonly` | `boolean` |  |  |
| `disabled` | `boolean` |  |  |
| `loading` | `boolean` |  | Shows a spinner and marks the field busy. |
| `clearable` | `boolean` |  | Adds a clear button once there is text; focus stays in the input. |
| `prefix` | `string` |  | Text before and after the value, such as "$" or "kg". Read as part of the description. |
| `suffix` | `string` |  |  |
| `maxlength` | `number` |  |  |
| `counter` | `boolean` |  | Show how many characters are used (of `maxlength` if set). |

## Usage

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, ref } from 'vue'
import Button from '@/components/ui/button.vue'
import Card from '@/components/ui/card.vue'
import PasswordField from '@/components/ui/password-field.vue'
import TextField from '@/components/ui/text-field.vue'

const name = ref('')
const email = ref('ada@')
const emailError = computed(() => (/^\S+@\S+\.\S+$/.test(email.value) ? undefined : 'Enter a full email address.'))
const handle = ref('ada')
const price = ref('12')
const note = ref('')
const signEmail = ref('')
const signPass = ref('')
</script>

<template>
  <div class="grid items-start gap-6 md:grid-cols-2">
    <TextField v-model="name" label="Name" placeholder="Hover and focus me" hint="As it appears on invoices." />
    <TextField v-model="email" label="Email" type="email" :error="emailError" required />
    <TextField v-model="handle" label="Handle" prefix="@" clearable />
    <TextField v-model="price" label="Price" prefix="$" suffix="USD" />
    <TextField v-model="note" label="Note" :maxlength="40" counter optional />
    <TextField label="Saving" model-value="Checking availability" loading />
    <TextField label="Read only" model-value="grace@example.com" readonly />
    <TextField label="Disabled" model-value="locked@example.com" disabled />
    <Card title="Sign in" class="md:col-span-2 md:max-w-sm">
      <TextField v-model="signEmail" label="Email" type="email" placeholder="you@example.com" />
      <PasswordField v-model="signPass" label="Password" />
      <div><Button>Sign in</Button></div>
    </Card>
  </div>
</template>
```

## Rules

- Style it through theme tokens, not classes: sui has one design per component and no variants. `tone` exists only on status components.
- You own the copy: edit the file if the design must change.

# Field

The shared anatomy of every input: label with Required/Optional, hint or error, and an aside for a counter.

Group: Forms. Registry item: http://localhost:5173/r/field.json

## Install

```sh
bunx shadcn-vue@latest add http://localhost:5173/r/field.json
```

Installs with: theme, utils, announce. npm packages: reka-ui.

Import it from your own copy: `import Field from '@/components/ui/field.vue'`.

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `label (required)` | `string` |  |  |
| `hint` | `string` |  |  |
| `error` | `string` |  |  |
| `required` | `boolean` |  |  |
| `optional` | `boolean` |  |  |
| `hideLabel` | `boolean` |  |  |
| `id` | `string` |  |  |
| `disabled` | `boolean` |  |  |

Slots: `default`, `aside`.

## Usage

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref } from 'vue'
import Field from '@/components/ui/field.vue'
import Slider from '@/components/ui/slider.vue'
import TextField from '@/components/ui/text-field.vue'

const volume = ref([40])
const name = ref('')
</script>

<template>
  <div class="grid items-start gap-6 md:grid-cols-2">
    <TextField v-model="name" label="Built on Field" hint="Label, hint, error and flag come from one place." required />
    <TextField label="Optional, with a counter" :maxlength="40" counter optional />
    <TextField label="Error" model-value="" error="This field is required." required />
    <Field v-slot="{ id }" label="Around any control" :hint="`${volume[0]}%`">
      <Slider v-model="volume" :labelledby="`${id}-label`" />
    </Field>
  </div>
</template>
```

## Rules

- Style it through theme tokens, not classes: sui has one design per component and no variants. `tone` exists only on status components.
- You own the copy: edit the file if the design must change.

# Form

Validates on submit, lists the problems as links to their fields, and moves focus to the list.

Group: Forms. Registry item: http://localhost:5173/r/form.json

## Install

```sh
bunx shadcn-vue@latest add http://localhost:5173/r/form.json
```

Installs with: theme, utils, notice. npm packages: none beyond Vue.

Import it from your own copy: `import Form from '@/components/ui/form.vue'`.

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `submitting` | `boolean` |  |  |

Events: `submit`.

Slots: `default`.

## Usage

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, ref } from 'vue'
import Button from '@/components/ui/button.vue'
import Card from '@/components/ui/card.vue'
import Form from '@/components/ui/form.vue'
import PasswordField from '@/components/ui/password-field.vue'
import TextField from '@/components/ui/text-field.vue'
import { toast } from '@/components/ui/toast.vue'

const form = ref<InstanceType<typeof Form>>()
const name = ref('')
const email = ref('grace@')
const password = ref('')
const submitting = ref(false)
const emailError = computed(() => (email.value && !/^\S+@\S+\.\S+$/.test(email.value) ? 'Enter a full email address.' : undefined))
const passwordError = computed(() => (password.value && password.value.length < 8 ? 'Use at least 8 characters.' : undefined))

function save() {
  submitting.value = true
  setTimeout(() => {
    submitting.value = false
    toast({ title: 'Account created', tone: 'success' })
  }, 900)
}
</script>

<template>
  <div class="grid items-start gap-6 md:grid-cols-2">
    <Card title="Create account">
      <Form ref="form" :submitting="submitting" @submit="save">
        <TextField v-model="name" label="Full name" required />
        <TextField v-model="email" label="Email" type="email" :error="emailError" required />
        <PasswordField v-model="password" label="Password" mode="new" :error="passwordError" required />
        <div class="flex flex-wrap gap-3">
          <Button type="submit" :disabled="submitting">{{ submitting ? 'Creating…' : 'Create account' }}</Button>
          <Button type="button" @click="form?.reset()">Reset</Button>
        </div>
      </Form>
    </Card>
    <p class="max-w-sm text-muted">Submit it empty: a summary lists each problem as a link and focus moves to it. Each link jumps to its field.</p>
  </div>
</template>
```

## Rules

- Style it through theme tokens, not classes: sui has one design per component and no variants. `tone` exists only on status components.
- You own the copy: edit the file if the design must change.


---

# Password field

Text field with a show/hide button and password-manager friendly attributes.

Group: Forms. Registry item: http://localhost:5173/r/password-field.json

## Install

```sh
bunx shadcn-vue@latest add http://localhost:5173/r/password-field.json
```

Installs with: theme, utils, field, announce. npm packages: none beyond Vue.

Import it from your own copy: `import Passwordfield from '@/components/ui/password-field.vue'`.

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `v-model` | `string` | `''` | Two-way bound value. |
| `label (required)` | `string` |  |  |
| `hint` | `string` |  |  |
| `error` | `string` |  |  |
| `required` | `boolean` |  |  |
| `optional` | `boolean` |  |  |
| `hideLabel` | `boolean` |  |  |
| `readonly` | `boolean` |  |  |
| `disabled` | `boolean` |  |  |
| `loading` | `boolean` |  |  |
| `mode` | `'current' \| 'new'` | `'current'` | 'current' for signing in, 'new' for choosing one: it sets autocomplete so a password manager does the right thing. |
| `rules` | `{ label: string; test: (value: string) => boolean }[]` |  | A checklist shown under the field: each rule is met when `test` returns true. |

## Usage

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, ref } from 'vue'
import Button from '@/components/ui/button.vue'
import Card from '@/components/ui/card.vue'
import PasswordField from '@/components/ui/password-field.vue'

const current = ref('')
const short = ref('abc')
const error = computed(() => (short.value && short.value.length < 8 ? 'Use at least 8 characters.' : undefined))
const fresh = ref('')
const rules = [
  { label: 'At least 8 characters', test: (v: string) => v.length >= 8 },
  { label: 'A number', test: (v: string) => /\d/.test(v) },
  { label: 'An upper-case letter', test: (v: string) => /[A-Z]/.test(v) },
]
</script>

<template>
  <div class="grid items-start gap-6 md:grid-cols-2">
    <PasswordField v-model="current" label="Password" placeholder="Reveal with the eye" />
    <PasswordField v-model="short" label="Error" :error="error" />
    <PasswordField label="Disabled" model-value="locked" disabled />
    <Card title="Choose a password">
      <PasswordField v-model="fresh" label="New password" mode="new" :rules="rules" />
      <div><Button :disabled="rules.some((r) => !r.test(fresh))">Save</Button></div>
    </Card>
  </div>
</template>
```

## Rules

- Style it through theme tokens, not classes: sui has one design per component and no variants. `tone` exists only on status components.
- You own the copy: edit the file if the design must change.


---

# Search field

Search input with an icon, a clear button and Escape to clear.

Group: Forms. Registry item: http://localhost:5173/r/search-field.json

## Install

```sh
bunx shadcn-vue@latest add http://localhost:5173/r/search-field.json
```

Installs with: theme, utils, field. npm packages: none beyond Vue.

Import it from your own copy: `import Searchfield from '@/components/ui/search-field.vue'`.

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `v-model` | `string` | `''` | Two-way bound value. |
| `label (required)` | `string` |  |  |
| `hint` | `string` |  |  |
| `error` | `string` |  |  |
| `hideLabel` | `boolean` |  |  |
| `readonly` | `boolean` |  |  |
| `disabled` | `boolean` |  |  |
| `loading` | `boolean` |  | Shows a spinner and marks the field busy. |
| `action` | `string` |  | Text of a submit button at the end of the field, such as "Search". It fires `search`, like Enter. |

Events: `clear`, `search`.

## Usage

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, ref } from 'vue'
import Card from '@/components/ui/card.vue'
import EmptyState from '@/components/ui/empty-state.vue'
import SearchField from '@/components/ui/search-field.vue'

const typed = ref('ap')
const submitted = ref('')
const busy = ref('slow query')
const q = ref('')
const items = ['Apple', 'Apricot', 'Banana', 'Blueberry', 'Cherry', 'Grape', 'Mango', 'Pear']
const hits = computed(() => items.filter((i) => i.toLowerCase().includes(q.value.trim().toLowerCase())))
</script>

<template>
  <div class="grid items-start gap-6 md:grid-cols-2">
    <SearchField v-model="typed" label="Clear with ✕ or Esc" placeholder="Search" />
    <SearchField v-model="submitted" label="With a button" placeholder="Search" action="Search" />
    <SearchField v-model="busy" label="Searching" loading />
    <SearchField label="Disabled" model-value="" placeholder="Search" disabled />
    <Card title="Filter a list" class="md:col-span-2 md:max-w-md">
      <SearchField v-model="q" label="Fruit" placeholder="Try “ap” or “zz”" />
      <ul v-if="hits.length" class="grid">
        <li v-for="h in hits" :key="h" class="border-b border-edge py-2 last:border-b-0">{{ h }}</li>
      </ul>
      <EmptyState v-else title="No matches" :description="`Nothing is called “${q}”.`" />
    </Card>
  </div>
</template>
```

## Rules

- Style it through theme tokens, not classes: sui has one design per component and no variants. `tone` exists only on status components.
- You own the copy: edit the file if the design must change.


---

# Checkbox

Labelled checkbox with indeterminate support.

Group: Forms. Registry item: http://localhost:5173/r/checkbox.json

## Install

```sh
bunx shadcn-vue@latest add http://localhost:5173/r/checkbox.json
```

Installs with: theme, utils. npm packages: reka-ui.

Import it from your own copy: `import Checkbox from '@/components/ui/checkbox.vue'`.

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `v-model` | `boolean \| 'indeterminate'` | `false` | Two-way bound value. |
| `label (required)` | `string` |  |  |
| `description` | `string` |  | A line of help under the label, read after the label rather than as part of its name. |
| `hideLabel` | `boolean` |  |  |
| `disabled` | `boolean` |  |  |
| `value` | `string` |  | Sent with the form when checked (default "on"), and the field name. |
| `name` | `string` |  |  |
| `required` | `boolean` |  |  |

## Usage

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, ref } from 'vue'
import Checkbox from '@/components/ui/checkbox.vue'

const terms = ref(true)
const news = ref(false)
const files = ref([true, false, false])
const names = ['report.pdf', 'budget.xlsx', 'notes.md']
const all = computed<boolean | 'indeterminate'>({
  get: () => (files.value.every(Boolean) ? true : files.value.some(Boolean) ? 'indeterminate' : false),
  set: (v) => (files.value = files.value.map(() => v === true)),
})
</script>

<template>
  <div class="grid items-start gap-8 md:grid-cols-2">
    <div class="grid gap-1">
      <Checkbox v-model="terms" label="I accept the terms" />
      <Checkbox v-model="news" label="Email me updates" description="At most one a month." />
      <Checkbox :model-value="true" label="Disabled, checked" disabled />
      <Checkbox :model-value="false" label="Disabled" disabled />
    </div>
    <div class="grid gap-1">
      <Checkbox v-model="all" label="Select all" />
      <div class="grid gap-1 ps-7">
        <Checkbox v-for="(n, i) in names" :key="n" v-model="files[i]" :label="n" />
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</template>
```

## Rules

- Style it through theme tokens, not classes: sui has one design per component and no variants. `tone` exists only on status components.
- You own the copy: edit the file if the design must change.


---

# Checkbox group

Pick any number of options, with an optional select-all.

Group: Forms. Registry item: http://localhost:5173/r/checkbox-group.json

## Install

```sh
bunx shadcn-vue@latest add http://localhost:5173/r/checkbox-group.json
```

Installs with: theme, utils, checkbox, fieldset. npm packages: none beyond Vue.

Import it from your own copy: `import Checkboxgroup from '@/components/ui/checkbox-group.vue'`.

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `v-model` | `string[]` | `[]` | Two-way bound value. |
| `legend (required)` | `string` |  |  |
| `options (required)` | `{ value: string; label: string; disabled?: boolean }[]` |  |  |
| `selectAll` | `string` |  | Adds a first checkbox that checks or clears everything; it shows the indeterminate state for a partial pick. |
| `hint` | `string` |  |  |
| `error` | `string` |  |  |
| `disabled` | `boolean` |  |  |
| `orientation` | `'vertical' \| 'horizontal'` |  |  |

## Usage

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, ref } from 'vue'
import CheckboxGroup from '@/components/ui/checkbox-group.vue'

const toppings = [
  { value: 'cheese', label: 'Extra cheese' },
  { value: 'olives', label: 'Olives' },
  { value: 'mushroom', label: 'Mushrooms' },
  { value: 'anchovy', label: 'Anchovies', disabled: true },
]
const picked = ref(['cheese'])
const days = ['Mon', 'Tue', 'Wed', 'Thu', 'Fri'].map((d) => ({ value: d, label: d }))
const workdays = ref(['Mon', 'Wed'])
const none = ref<string[]>([])
const error = computed(() => (none.value.length ? undefined : 'Pick at least one.'))
</script>

<template>
  <div class="grid items-start gap-8 md:grid-cols-2">
    <CheckboxGroup v-model="picked" legend="Toppings" hint="Anchovies are sold out." :options="toppings" select-all="Everything" />
    <CheckboxGroup v-model="workdays" legend="Days" orientation="horizontal" :options="days" />
    <CheckboxGroup v-model="none" legend="Error" :options="toppings.slice(0, 3)" :error="error" />
    <CheckboxGroup :model-value="['cheese']" legend="Disabled" :options="toppings.slice(0, 3)" disabled />
  </div>
</template>
```

## Rules

- Style it through theme tokens, not classes: sui has one design per component and no variants. `tone` exists only on status components.
- You own the copy: edit the file if the design must change.


---

# Radio group

Pick exactly one option.

Group: Forms. Registry item: http://localhost:5173/r/radio-group.json

## Install

```sh
bunx shadcn-vue@latest add http://localhost:5173/r/radio-group.json
```

Installs with: theme, utils. npm packages: reka-ui.

Import it from your own copy: `import Radiogroup from '@/components/ui/radio-group.vue'`.

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `v-model` | `string` |  | Two-way bound value. |
| `options (required)` | `{ value: string; label: string; /** A line of help under the label. */ description?: string; disabled?: boolean }[]` |  |  |
| `hideLabel` | `boolean` |  | Hide every option's label visually (they stay for screen readers); useful for a table of radios. |
| `name` | `string` |  |  |
| `required` | `boolean` |  |  |
| `disabled` | `boolean` |  |  |

## Usage

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref } from 'vue'
import RadioGroup from '@/components/ui/radio-group.vue'

const plan = ref('team')
const billing = ref('annual')
const options = [
  { value: 'free', label: 'Free' },
  { value: 'team', label: 'Team' },
  { value: 'scale', label: 'Scale' },
]
const withDisabled = [
  { value: 'free', label: 'Free' },
  { value: 'team', label: 'Team' },
  { value: 'scale', label: 'Scale', disabled: true },
]
const tiers = [
  { value: 'monthly', label: 'Monthly', description: '$12 a month, cancel any time.' },
  { value: 'annual', label: 'Annual', description: '$99 a year, two months free.' },
]
</script>

<template>
  <div class="grid items-start gap-8 md:grid-cols-2">
    <RadioGroup v-model="plan" :options="options" />
    <RadioGroup v-model="billing" :options="tiers" />
    <RadioGroup model-value="free" :options="withDisabled" />
    <RadioGroup model-value="team" :options="options" disabled />
  </div>
</template>
```

## Rules

# Select

Dropdown list with keyboard typeahead, groups, multi-select and clear.

Group: Forms. Registry item: http://localhost:5173/r/select.json

## Install

```sh
bunx shadcn-vue@latest add http://localhost:5173/r/select.json
```

Installs with: theme, utils, field, spinner. npm packages: reka-ui.

Import it from your own copy: `import Select from '@/components/ui/select.vue'`.

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `v-model` | `T` |  | Two-way bound value. |
| `options (required)` | `{ value: string; label: string; description?: string; group?: string; disabled?: boolean }[]` |  | `group` puts options under a heading (keep a group's options together); `description` is a second line. |
| `placeholder` | `string` |  |  |
| `label` | `string` |  | Optional: without one the select carries a hidden label so it still has an accessible name. |
| `hint` | `string` |  |  |
| `error` | `string` |  |  |
| `required` | `boolean` |  |  |
| `optional` | `boolean` |  |  |
| `multiple` | `boolean` |  | Pick several: the model is then a string[] and the trigger reads "3 selected". |
| `clearable` | `boolean` |  | Show a clear button once something is picked. |
| `loading` | `boolean` |  | Options are on their way: shows a spinner and sets aria-busy. |
| `disabled` | `boolean` |  |  |

## Usage

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref } from 'vue'
import Select from '@/components/ui/select.vue'

const fruit = ref<string>()
const roles = ref<string[]>(['read'])
const region = ref<string>('eu')
const picked = ref<string>()
const options = [
  { value: 'apple', label: 'Apple' },
  { value: 'mango', label: 'Mango' },
  { value: 'pear', label: 'Pear' },
  { value: 'durian', label: 'Durian (sold out)', disabled: true },
]
const roleOptions = [
  { value: 'read', label: 'Read', description: 'View everything' },
  { value: 'write', label: 'Write', description: 'Create and edit' },
  { value: 'admin', label: 'Admin', description: 'Manage people and billing' },
]
const regions = [
  { value: 'us-e', label: 'US East', group: 'Americas' },
  { value: 'us-w', label: 'US West', group: 'Americas' },
  { value: 'eu', label: 'Frankfurt', group: 'Europe' },
  { value: 'uk', label: 'London', group: 'Europe' },
  { value: 'ap', label: 'Singapore', group: 'Asia Pacific' },
]
</script>

<template>
  <div class="grid items-start gap-6 md:grid-cols-2">
    <Select v-model="fruit" :options="options" label="Fruit" placeholder="Pick a fruit" hint="Durian is sold out." />
    <Select v-model="roles" :options="roleOptions" label="Roles" multiple clearable placeholder="Choose roles" />
    <Select v-model="region" :options="regions" label="Region" clearable />
    <Select v-model="picked" :options="options" label="Favourite fruit" required placeholder="Pick one" :error="picked ? undefined : 'Pick a fruit to continue.'" />
    <Select model-value="pear" :options="options" label="Locked" disabled />
    <Select :options="[]" label="Loading" loading placeholder="Fetching options…" />
  </div>
</template>
```

## Rules

- Style it through theme tokens, not classes: sui has one design per component and no variants. `tone` exists only on status components.
- You own the copy: edit the file if the design must change.


---

# Slider

Pick a value or range along a track.

Group: Forms. Registry item: http://localhost:5173/r/slider.json

## Install

```sh
bunx shadcn-vue@latest add http://localhost:5173/r/slider.json
```

Installs with: theme, utils. npm packages: reka-ui.

Import it from your own copy: `import Slider from '@/components/ui/slider.vue'`.

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `v-model` | `number[]` | `[0]` | Two-way bound value. |
| `min` | `number` | `0` |  |
| `max` | `number` | `100` |  |
| `step` | `number` | `1` |  |
| `disabled` | `boolean` |  |  |
| `name` | `string` |  |  |
| `label` | `string` |  | The control's accessible name. A two-thumb range reads "<label> minimum" and "<label> maximum". |
| `labelledby` | `string` |  | Id of a visible label (a Field's `${id}-label`) to name a single thumb instead of `label`. |
| `valueText` | `string \| ((value: number, index: number) => string)` |  | What a screen reader hears for the value, e.g. "$40": a string (shared) or a function of the value and thumb index. |
| `marks` | `Mark[]` |  | Ticks along the track, each optionally with a label. |

## Usage

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref } from 'vue'
import Field from '@/components/ui/field.vue'
import Slider from '@/components/ui/slider.vue'

const volume = ref([40])
const range = ref([20, 70])
const stepped = ref([30])
const budget = ref([50])
const price = ref([150, 600])
</script>

<template>
  <div class="grid items-start gap-8 md:grid-cols-2">
    <Field v-slot="{ id }" label="Volume" :hint="`${volume[0]}%`">
      <Slider v-model="volume" :labelledby="`${id}-label`" />
    </Field>
    <Field label="Range" :hint="`${range[0]} to ${range[1]}`">
      <Slider v-model="range" label="Range" />
    </Field>
    <Field v-slot="{ id }" label="Steps of 10" :hint="`${stepped[0]}`">
      <Slider v-model="stepped" :step="10" :labelledby="`${id}-label`" />
    </Field>
    <Field v-slot="{ id }" label="Budget" hint="Marks are decoration; the value is spoken in dollars.">
      <Slider v-model="budget" :labelledby="`${id}-label`" :value-text="(v) => `$${v}`" :marks="[{ value: 0, label: '$0' }, { value: 50, label: '$50' }, { value: 100, label: '$100' }]" />
    </Field>
    <Field label="Price" :hint="`$${price[0]} to $${price[1]}`" class="md:col-span-2">
      <Slider v-model="price" :min="0" :max="1000" :step="10" label="Price" />
    </Field>
    <Field v-slot="{ id }" label="Disabled" disabled>
      <Slider :model-value="[60]" disabled :labelledby="`${id}-label`" />
    </Field>
  </div>
</template>
```

## Rules

- Style it through theme tokens, not classes: sui has one design per component and no variants. `tone` exists only on status components.
- You own the copy: edit the file if the design must change.


---


## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `v-model` | `boolean` | `false` | Two-way bound value. |

Slots: `default`.

## Usage

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref } from 'vue'
import Toggle from '@/components/ui/toggle.vue'

const italic = ref(false)
const underline = ref(false)

</script>

<template>
  <div class="grid gap-6">
    <div class="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
      <Toggle v-model="bold" aria-label="Bold">Bold</Toggle>
      <Toggle v-model="italic" aria-label="Italic">Italic</Toggle>
      <Toggle v-model="underline" aria-label="Underline">Underline</Toggle>
      <Toggle :model-value="true" disabled>Disabled, on</Toggle>
      <Toggle disabled>Disabled</Toggle>
    </div>
    <div><Toggle v-model="starred">{{ starred ? 'Starred' : 'Star' }}</Toggle></div>
  </div>
</template>
```

# Toggle group

Segmented single-choice control; can stretch to fill the width.

Group: Forms. Registry item: http://localhost:5173/r/toggle-group.json

## Install

```sh
bunx shadcn-vue@latest add http://localhost:5173/r/toggle-group.json
```

Installs with: theme, utils. npm packages: reka-ui.

Import it from your own copy: `import Togglegroup from '@/components/ui/toggle-group.vue'`.

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `v-model` | `string` |  | Two-way bound value. |
| `options (required)` | `{ value: string; label: string; disabled?: boolean }[]` |  |  |
| `stretch` | `boolean` |  | Fill the available width, items sharing it equally. |

## Usage

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref } from 'vue'
import ToggleGroup from '@/components/ui/toggle-group.vue'

const view = ref('grid')
const period = ref('month')
const stretched = ref('week')
const options = [
  { value: 'grid', label: 'Grid' },
  { value: 'list', label: 'List' },
  { value: 'board', label: 'Board' },
]
const periods = [
  { value: 'week', label: 'Week' },
  { value: 'month', label: 'Month' },
  { value: 'year', label: 'Year' },
]
const withDisabled = [
  { value: 'a', label: 'Free' },
  { value: 'b', label: 'Team' },
  { value: 'c', label: 'Scale', disabled: true },
]
const pick = ref('a')
</script>

<template>
  <div class="grid items-start gap-6 md:grid-cols-2">
    <ToggleGroup v-model="view" :options="options" />
    <ToggleGroup v-model="period" :options="periods" />
    <ToggleGroup v-model="pick" :options="withDisabled" />
    <ToggleGroup v-model="stretched" :options="periods" stretch />
  </div>
</template>
```

## Rules

- Style it through theme tokens, not classes: sui has one design per component and no variants. `tone` exists only on status components.
- You own the copy: edit the file if the design must change.

# Combobox

Type to filter a list and pick one or many, with groups, descriptions, clear, loading and freeform entry.

Group: Forms. Registry item: http://localhost:5173/r/combobox.json

## Install

```sh
bunx shadcn-vue@latest add http://localhost:5173/r/combobox.json
```

Installs with: theme, utils, field, spinner, announce. npm packages: reka-ui.

Import it from your own copy: `import Combobox from '@/components/ui/combobox.vue'`.

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `v-model` | `string \| string[]` |  | Two-way bound value. |
| `options (required)` | `{ value: string; label: string; description?: string; group?: string; disabled?: boolean }[]` |  | `group` puts options under a heading (options of one group should sit together); `description` is a second line. |
| `label` | `string` |  |  |
| `placeholder` | `string` |  |  |
| `error` | `string` |  |  |
| `hint` | `string` |  |  |
| `required` | `boolean` |  |  |
| `optional` | `boolean` |  |  |
| `clearable` | `boolean` |  | Show a clear button once something is picked. |
| `loading` | `boolean` |  | Options are on their way: shows a spinner, sets aria-busy, and the empty row says Loading. |
| `emptyText` | `string` |  | The text of the empty row. |
| `freeform` | `boolean` |  | Accept whatever is typed (Enter or leaving the field commits it) as well as the listed options. |
| `multiple` | `boolean` |  | Pick several: the model is then a string[] and the picks show as chips in the field. |
| `disabled` | `boolean` |  |  |

## Usage

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { onBeforeUnmount, ref } from 'vue'
import Card from '@/components/ui/card.vue'
import Combobox from '@/components/ui/combobox.vue'

const country = ref<string>('nz')
const visited = ref<string[]>(['jp', 'se'])
const plan = ref<string>()
const tags = ref<string[]>(['design'])
const needed = ref<string[]>([])
const options = [
  { value: 'au', label: 'Australia' },
  { value: 'ca', label: 'Canada' },
  { value: 'fr', label: 'France' },
  { value: 'jp', label: 'Japan' },
  { value: 'nz', label: 'New Zealand' },
  { value: 'se', label: 'Sweden' },
]
const plans = [
  { value: 'free', label: 'Free', description: 'One project', group: 'Personal' },
  { value: 'pro', label: 'Pro', description: 'Unlimited projects', group: 'Personal' },
  { value: 'team', label: 'Team', description: 'Shared workspaces, roles', group: 'Business' },
  { value: 'scale', label: 'Scale', description: 'SSO and audit log', group: 'Business' },
]
const tagOptions = ['design', 'research', 'engineering'].map((t) => ({ value: t, label: t }))

// Options that arrive after a moment.
const reviewer = ref<string>()
const people = ref<{ value: string; label: string }[]>([])
const loading = ref(true)
const timer = setTimeout(() => {
  people.value = ['Ada Lovelace', 'Alan Turing', 'Grace Hopper'].map((n) => ({ value: n, label: n }))
  loading.value = false
}, 1500)
onBeforeUnmount(() => clearTimeout(timer))
</script>

<template>
  <div class="grid items-start gap-6 md:grid-cols-2">
    <Combobox v-model="country" :options="options" label="Home country" placeholder="Search countries" hint="Start typing to filter." />
    <Combobox v-model="visited" :options="options" label="Countries visited" placeholder="Add more" multiple clearable />
    <Combobox v-model="plan" :options="plans" label="Plan" placeholder="Choose a plan" optional />
    <Combobox v-model="tags" :options="tagOptions" label="Tags" placeholder="Type, then Enter" multiple freeform hint="Pick one, or type your own." />
    <Combobox v-model="needed" :options="options" label="Countries" placeholder="Add a country" multiple required :error="needed.length ? undefined : 'Choose at least one country.'" />
    <Combobox model-value="ca" :options="options" label="Locked" disabled />
    <Card title="Assign a reviewer" class="md:col-span-2 md:max-w-sm">
      <Combobox v-model="reviewer" :options="people" label="Reviewer" placeholder="Search people" :loading="loading" clearable />
    </Card>
  </div>
</template>
```

## Rules

- Style it through theme tokens, not classes: sui has one design per component and no variants. `tone` exists only on status components.
- You own the copy: edit the file if the design must change.


---

# Calendar

Month grid for picking a date, with presets, marked days and a Today/Clear footer.

Group: Forms. Registry item: http://localhost:5173/r/calendar.json

## Install

```sh
bunx shadcn-vue@latest add http://localhost:5173/r/calendar.json
```

Installs with: theme, utils. npm packages: reka-ui, @internationalized/date.

Import it from your own copy: `import Calendar from '@/components/ui/calendar.vue'`.

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `v-model` | `DateValue` |  | Two-way bound value. |
| `minValue` | `DateValue` |  |  |
| `maxValue` | `DateValue` |  |  |
| `disabledDate` | `(date: DateValue) => boolean` |  | Dates that can't be picked, beyond min and max: return true to block one. |
| `marked` | `DateValue[]` |  | Dates to flag with a dot (events, availability, deadlines). |
| `footer` | `boolean` |  | A Today / Clear row under the grid. |

## Usage

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { shallowRef } from 'vue'
import { today, getLocalTimeZone, type DateValue } from '@internationalized/date'
import Calendar from '@/components/ui/calendar.vue'

const now = today(getLocalTimeZone())
const picked = shallowRef<DateValue>(now)
const limited = shallowRef<DateValue>()
const events = shallowRef<DateValue>()

const marked = [now.add({ days: 2 }), now.add({ days: 5 }), now.add({ days: 9 })]
// Weekends can't be picked.
const noWeekends = (d: DateValue) => [0, 6].includes(d.toDate(getLocalTimeZone()).getDay())
</script>

<template>
  <div class="flex flex-wrap items-start gap-x-12 gap-y-8">
    <div class="grid gap-2">
      <p class="kicker">Click the month to jump by year</p>
      <Calendar v-model="picked" />
    </div>
    <div class="grid gap-2">
      <p class="kicker">Next 30 days, weekdays only</p>
      <Calendar v-model="limited" :min-value="now" :max-value="now.add({ days: 30 })" :disabled-date="noWeekends" />
    </div>
    <div class="grid gap-2">
      <p class="kicker">Marked days, with Today and Clear</p>
      <Calendar v-model="events" :marked="marked" footer />
    </div>
  </div>
</template>
```

## Rules

- Style it through theme tokens, not classes: sui has one design per component and no variants. `tone` exists only on status components.
- You own the copy: edit the file if the design must change.


---

# Date picker

Field that opens a calendar in a popover.

Group: Forms. Registry item: http://localhost:5173/r/date-picker.json

## Install

```sh
bunx shadcn-vue@latest add http://localhost:5173/r/date-picker.json
```

Installs with: theme, utils, calendar, field. npm packages: reka-ui, @internationalized/date.

Import it from your own copy: `import Datepicker from '@/components/ui/date-picker.vue'`.

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `v-model` | `DateValue` |  | Two-way bound value. |
| `label (required)` | `string` |  |  |
| `placeholder` | `string` |  |  |
| `minValue` | `DateValue` |  |  |
| `maxValue` | `DateValue` |  |  |
| `disabledDate` | `(date: DateValue) => boolean` |  |  |
| `marked` | `DateValue[]` |  |  |
| `footer` | `boolean` |  |  |
| `error` | `string` |  |  |
| `hint` | `string` |  |  |
| `required` | `boolean` |  |  |
| `optional` | `boolean` |  |  |
| `name` | `string` |  | Submits the date as YYYY-MM-DD with a form. |
| `disabled` | `boolean` |  |  |

## Usage

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, shallowRef } from 'vue'
import { today, getLocalTimeZone, type DateValue } from '@internationalized/date'
import Card from '@/components/ui/card.vue'
import DatePicker from '@/components/ui/date-picker.vue'

const now = today(getLocalTimeZone())
const due = shallowRef<DateValue>()
const delivery = shallowRef<DateValue>(now.add({ days: 6 }))
const start = shallowRef<DateValue>(now.subtract({ days: 12 }))
const startError = computed(() => (start.value && start.value.compare(now) < 0 ? 'Choose today or a later date.' : undefined))
const day = shallowRef<DateValue>()
const busy = [now.add({ days: 1 }), now.add({ days: 4 })]
// Not on weekends.
const weekend = (d: DateValue) => [0, 6].includes(d.toDate(getLocalTimeZone()).getDay())
</script>

<template>
  <div class="grid items-start gap-6 md:grid-cols-2">
    <DatePicker v-model="due" label="Due date" placeholder="Pick a due date" :min-value="now" required hint="Today or later." />
    <DatePicker v-model="delivery" label="Delivery" :min-value="now" :max-value="now.add({ days: 30 })" footer optional />
    <DatePicker v-model="start" label="Start date" :error="startError" />
    <DatePicker label="Locked" disabled />
    <Card title="Schedule a call" class="md:col-span-2 md:max-w-sm">
      <DatePicker v-model="day" label="Day" :disabled-date="weekend" :marked="busy" :min-value="now" footer name="day" hint="Dots are busy days." />
      <p class="numeral text-sm text-muted">Submits as <span class="text-ink">{{ day?.toString() ?? 'nothing yet' }}</span></p>
    </Card>
  </div>
</template>
```

## Rules

- Style it through theme tokens, not classes: sui has one design per component and no variants. `tone` exists only on status components.
- You own the copy: edit the file if the design must change.


---

# Date range picker

Pick a start and end date from one calendar popover.

Group: Forms. Registry item: http://localhost:5173/r/date-range-picker.json

## Install

```sh
bunx shadcn-vue@latest add http://localhost:5173/r/date-range-picker.json
```

Installs with: theme, utils, range-calendar, field. npm packages: reka-ui, @internationalized/date.

Import it from your own copy: `import Daterangepicker from '@/components/ui/date-range-picker.vue'`.

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `v-model` | `DateRange` | `({ start: undefined, end: undefined })` | Two-way bound value. |
| `label (required)` | `string` |  |  |
| `placeholder` | `string` |  |  |
| `minValue` | `DateValue` |  |  |
| `maxValue` | `DateValue` |  |  |
| `disabledDate` | `(date: DateValue) => boolean` |  |  |
| `marked` | `DateValue[]` |  |  |
| `presets` | `{ label: string; value: { start: DateValue; end: DateValue } }[]` |  |  |
| `footer` | `boolean` |  |  |
| `error` | `string` |  |  |
| `hint` | `string` |  |  |
| `required` | `boolean` |  |  |
| `optional` | `boolean` |  |  |
| `startName` | `string` |  | Submit the two ends as YYYY-MM-DD with a form. |
| `endName` | `string` |  |  |
| `disabled` | `boolean` |  |  |

## Usage

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, shallowRef } from 'vue'
import { today, getLocalTimeZone } from '@internationalized/date'
import type { DateRange } from 'reka-ui'
import DateRangePicker from '@/components/ui/date-range-picker.vue'

const now = today(getLocalTimeZone())
const stay = shallowRef<DateRange>({ start: undefined, end: undefined })
const long = shallowRef<DateRange>({ start: now, end: now.add({ days: 40 }) })
const longError = computed(() => (long.value.start && long.value.end && long.value.end.compare(long.value.start.add({ days: 30 })) > 0 ? 'Bookings are limited to 30 nights.' : undefined))
const report = shallowRef<DateRange>({ start: now.subtract({ days: 6 }), end: now })
const presets = [
  { label: 'Last 7 days', value: { start: now.subtract({ days: 6 }), end: now } },
  { label: 'Last 30 days', value: { start: now.subtract({ days: 29 }), end: now } },
  { label: 'This month', value: { start: now.set({ day: 1 }), end: now } },
]
</script>

<template>
  <div class="grid items-start gap-6 md:grid-cols-2">
    <DateRangePicker v-model="stay" label="Dates of stay" placeholder="Check in – check out" :min-value="now" required hint="From today onwards." />
    <DateRangePicker v-model="report" label="Report period" :presets="presets" footer start-name="from" end-name="to" :max-value="now" />
    <DateRangePicker v-model="long" label="Long booking" :error="longError" />
    <DateRangePicker label="Locked" disabled />
  </div>
</template>
```

## Rules

- Style it through theme tokens, not classes: sui has one design per component and no variants. `tone` exists only on status components.
- You own the copy: edit the file if the design must change.


---

# Range calendar

Month grid for picking a start and end date, with a band between, presets and marked days.

Group: Forms. Registry item: http://localhost:5173/r/range-calendar.json

## Install

```sh
bunx shadcn-vue@latest add http://localhost:5173/r/range-calendar.json
```

Installs with: theme, utils. npm packages: reka-ui, @internationalized/date.

Import it from your own copy: `import Rangecalendar from '@/components/ui/range-calendar.vue'`.

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `v-model` | `DateRange` | `({ start: undefined, end: undefined })` | Two-way bound value. |
| `minValue` | `DateValue` |  |  |
| `maxValue` | `DateValue` |  |  |
| `disabledDate` | `(date: DateValue) => boolean` |  | Dates that can't be picked, beyond min and max: return true to block one. |
| `marked` | `DateValue[]` |  | Dates to flag with a dot (events, availability, deadlines). |
| `presets` | `{ label: string; value: { start: DateValue; end: DateValue } }[]` |  | Quick picks shown under the grid, e.g. { label: 'Last 7 days', value: { start, end } }. |
| `footer` | `boolean` |  | A Clear row under the grid. |

## Usage

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { shallowRef } from 'vue'
import { CalendarDate, today, getLocalTimeZone } from '@internationalized/date'
import type { DateRange } from 'reka-ui'
import RangeCalendar from '@/components/ui/range-calendar.vue'

const now = today(getLocalTimeZone())
const across = shallowRef<DateRange>({ start: new CalendarDate(2026, 11, 26), end: new CalendarDate(2026, 12, 4) })
const quick = shallowRef<DateRange>({ start: undefined, end: undefined })
const booked = shallowRef<DateRange>({ start: undefined, end: undefined })

const presets = [
  { label: 'Last 7 days', value: { start: now.subtract({ days: 6 }), end: now } },
  { label: 'Last 30 days', value: { start: now.subtract({ days: 29 }), end: now } },
]
const holidays = [now.add({ days: 3 }), now.add({ days: 10 })]
// Sundays are closed.
const closed = (d: { toDate: (tz: string) => Date }) => d.toDate(getLocalTimeZone()).getDay() === 0
</script>

<template>
  <div class="flex flex-wrap items-start gap-x-12 gap-y-8">
    <div class="grid gap-2">
      <p class="kicker">Across a month boundary</p>
      <RangeCalendar v-model="across" />
    </div>
    <div class="grid gap-2">
      <p class="kicker">Presets and Clear</p>
      <RangeCalendar v-model="quick" :presets="presets" footer />
    </div>
    <div class="grid gap-2">
      <p class="kicker">Marked days, Sundays closed, next 21 days</p>
      <RangeCalendar v-model="booked" :marked="holidays" :disabled-date="closed" :min-value="now" :max-value="now.add({ days: 21 })" />
    </div>
  </div>
</template>
```

## Rules

- Style it through theme tokens, not classes: sui has one design per component and no variants. `tone` exists only on status components.
- You own the copy: edit the file if the design must change.


---

# Time field

Segmented hour and minute input.

Group: Forms. Registry item: http://localhost:5173/r/time-field.json

## Install

```sh
bunx shadcn-vue@latest add http://localhost:5173/r/time-field.json
```

Installs with: theme, utils, field. npm packages: reka-ui, @internationalized/date.

Import it from your own copy: `import Timefield from '@/components/ui/time-field.vue'`.

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `v-model` | `TimeValue` |  | Two-way bound value. |
| `label (required)` | `string` |  |  |
| `hint` | `string` |  |  |
| `required` | `boolean` |  |  |
| `optional` | `boolean` |  |  |
| `error` | `string` |  |  |
| `disabled` | `boolean` |  |  |

## Usage

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, shallowRef } from 'vue'
import { Time } from '@internationalized/date'
import type { TimeValue } from 'reka-ui'
import TimeField from '@/components/ui/time-field.vue'

const start = shallowRef<TimeValue>(new Time(9, 30))
const open = shallowRef<TimeValue>(new Time(17, 0))
const close = shallowRef<TimeValue>(new Time(8, 0))
const closeError = computed(() => (close.value && open.value && String(close.value) < String(open.value) ? 'Closing time must be after opening.' : undefined))
</script>

<template>
  <div class="grid items-start gap-6 md:grid-cols-2">
    <TimeField v-model="start" label="Starts at" hint="Type the digits; arrows step." />
    <TimeField :model-value="undefined" label="Not set" optional />
    <TimeField v-model="open" label="Opens" />
    <TimeField v-model="close" label="Closes" :error="closeError" />
    <TimeField :model-value="new Time(12, 0)" label="Locked" disabled />
  </div>
</template>
```

## Rules

- Style it through theme tokens, not classes: sui has one design per component and no variants. `tone` exists only on status components.
- You own the copy: edit the file if the design must change.

# Fieldset

Groups related controls under a legend with a shared hint and error.

Group: Forms. Registry item: http://localhost:5173/r/fieldset.json

## Install

```sh
bunx shadcn-vue@latest add http://localhost:5173/r/fieldset.json
```

Installs with: theme, utils. npm packages: none beyond Vue.

Import it from your own copy: `import Fieldset from '@/components/ui/fieldset.vue'`.

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `legend (required)` | `string` |  |  |
| `hint` | `string` |  |  |
| `error` | `string` |  |  |
| `disabled` | `boolean` |  |  |
| `orientation` | `'vertical' \| 'horizontal'` | `'vertical'` |  |

Slots: `default`.

## Usage

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref } from 'vue'
import Checkbox from '@/components/ui/checkbox.vue'
import Fieldset from '@/components/ui/fieldset.vue'
import RadioGroup from '@/components/ui/radio-group.vue'

const plan = ref('team')
const plans = [
  { value: 'free', label: 'Free' },
  { value: 'team', label: 'Team' },
  { value: 'scale', label: 'Scale' },
]
const a = ref(true)
const b = ref(false)
</script>

<template>
  <div class="grid items-start gap-8 md:grid-cols-2">
    <Fieldset legend="Plan" hint="You can change it later."><RadioGroup v-model="plan" :options="plans" /></Fieldset>
    <Fieldset legend="Notify me" error="Pick at least one.">
      <Checkbox v-model="a" label="Email" />
      <Checkbox v-model="b" label="Text message" />
    </Fieldset>
    <Fieldset legend="In a row" orientation="horizontal">
      <Checkbox v-model="a" label="Email" />
      <Checkbox v-model="b" label="Text" />
    </Fieldset>
    <Fieldset legend="Disabled" disabled>
      <Checkbox :model-value="true" label="Email" />
      <Checkbox :model-value="false" label="Text message" />
    </Fieldset>
  </div>
</template>
```

## Rules

- Style it through theme tokens, not classes: sui has one design per component and no variants. `tone` exists only on status components.
- You own the copy: edit the file if the design must change.

# Color picker

Pick a colour from an area, a hue slider, swatches or a hex field.

Group: Forms. Registry item: http://localhost:5173/r/color-picker.json

## Install

```sh
bunx shadcn-vue@latest add http://localhost:5173/r/color-picker.json
```

Installs with: theme, utils. npm packages: reka-ui.

Import it from your own copy: `import Colorpicker from '@/components/ui/color-picker.vue'`.

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `v-model` | `string` | `'#2c95b4'` | Two-way bound value. |
| `label (required)` | `string` |  |  |
| `swatches` | `string[]` | `['#2c95b4', '#005f7c', '#2e7d4f', '#d89614', '#d6561f', '#b3261e', '#7a3e9d', '#242424']` |  |
| `error` | `string` |  |  |
| `disabled` | `boolean` |  |  |

## Usage

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, ref } from 'vue'
import ColorPicker from '@/components/ui/color-picker.vue'

const brand = ref('#2c95b4')
const accent = ref('#f4efe2')

// A rough light-or-dark test, to show the error state.
const tooLight = computed(() => {
  const n = parseInt(accent.value.slice(1), 16)
  return 0.299 * (n >> 16) + 0.587 * ((n >> 8) & 255) + 0.114 * (n & 255) > 170
})
</script>

<template>
  <div class="grid items-start gap-8 md:grid-cols-3">
    <div class="grid content-start gap-3">
      <ColorPicker v-model="brand" label="Brand colour" />
      <p class="numeral text-sm text-muted">Picked: {{ brand }}</p>
    </div>
    <ColorPicker v-model="accent" label="Accent" :swatches="['#d6561f', '#f4efe2', '#7a3e9d', '#1d4e5a']" :error="tooLight ? 'Too light for white text.' : undefined" />
    <ColorPicker model-value="#7a3e9d" label="Locked" disabled />
  </div>
</template>
```

## Rules

- Style it through theme tokens, not classes: sui has one design per component and no variants. `tone` exists only on status components.
- You own the copy: edit the file if the design must change.

# Pin input

One box per character, for one-time codes.

Group: Forms. Registry item: http://localhost:5173/r/pin-input.json

## Install

```sh
bunx shadcn-vue@latest add http://localhost:5173/r/pin-input.json
```

Installs with: theme, utils, field. npm packages: reka-ui.

Import it from your own copy: `import Pininput from '@/components/ui/pin-input.vue'`.

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `v-model` | `string` | `''` | Two-way bound value. |
| `label (required)` | `string` |  |  |
| `hint` | `string` |  |  |
| `length` | `number` | `6` |  |
| `groupSize` | `number` |  | Show a wider gap after every N boxes, so 123456 reads as 123 456. |
| `charset` | `'numeric' \| 'alphanumeric' \| 'any'` | `'any'` | Which characters are allowed: digits, letters and digits, or anything. |
| `error` | `string` |  |  |
| `required` | `boolean` |  |  |
| `optional` | `boolean` |  |  |
| `hideLabel` | `boolean` |  |  |
| `readonly` | `boolean` |  |  |
| `disabled` | `boolean` |  |  |
| `name` | `string` |  |  |

Events: `complete`.

## Usage

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, ref } from 'vue'
import PinInput from '@/components/ui/pin-input.vue'

const code = ref('')
const done = ref(false)
const error = computed(() => (done.value && code.value !== '123456' ? 'That code is not right. Try 123456.' : undefined))
const grouped = ref('')
const letters = ref('')
const short = ref('')
</script>

<template>
  <div class="grid items-start gap-6 md:grid-cols-2">
    <PinInput v-model="code" label="Code" hint="Paste works. Try 123456." :error="error" @complete="done = true" />
    <PinInput v-model="grouped" label="In groups of three" :group-size="3" charset="numeric" />
    <PinInput v-model="letters" label="Letters and digits" :length="4" charset="alphanumeric" />
    <PinInput v-model="short" label="Four digits" :length="4" charset="numeric" optional />
    <PinInput label="Read only" model-value="123456" readonly />
    <PinInput label="Disabled" model-value="123456" disabled />
  </div>
</template>
```

## Rules

- Style it through theme tokens, not classes: sui has one design per component and no variants. `tone` exists only on status components.
- You own the copy: edit the file if the design must change.

```vue
    <TagsInput v-model="few" label="Error" :error="fewError" required />
    <TagsInput :model-value="['ada', 'grace']" label="Saving" loading />
    <TagsInput :model-value="['ada', 'grace']" label="Read only" readonly />
    <TagsInput :model-value="['ada', 'grace']" label="Disabled" disabled />
  </div>
</template>
```

# Label

Standalone label that stays tied to its control.

Group: Forms. Registry item: http://localhost:5173/r/label.json

## Install

```sh
bunx shadcn-vue@latest add http://localhost:5173/r/label.json
```

Installs with: theme, utils. npm packages: reka-ui.

Import it from your own copy: `import Label from '@/components/ui/label.vue'`.

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `required` | `boolean` |  |  |
| `optional` | `boolean` |  |  |

Also takes everything in LabelProps, and `class` for placement only.

Slots: `default`.

## Usage

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { useId } from 'vue'
import Label from '@/components/ui/label.vue'

const email = useId()
const handle = useId()
const note = useId()
</script>

<template>
  <div class="grid max-w-md gap-6">
    <p class="text-muted">The bare label for a control you wire yourself. For ready-made inputs, use Field: it does the wiring for you.</p>
    <div class="grid gap-2">
      <Label :for="email" required>Email</Label>
      <input :id="email" type="email" required placeholder="you@example.com" class="well h-control w-full px-4" />
    </div>
    <div class="grid gap-2">
      <Label :for="handle" optional>Handle</Label>
      <input :id="handle" type="text" placeholder="grace" :aria-describedby="`${handle}-hint`" class="well h-control w-full px-4" />
      <p :id="`${handle}-hint`" class="text-sm text-muted">Lowercase letters and numbers only.</p>
    </div>
    <div class="grid gap-2">
      <Label :for="note">Locked</Label>
      <input :id="note" disabled value="Cannot edit" class="well h-control w-full px-4" />
    </div>
  </div>
</template>
```

## Rules

- Style it through theme tokens, not classes: sui has one design per component and no variants. `tone` exists only on status components.
- You own the copy: edit the file if the design must change.

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `v-model` | `File[]` | `[]` | Two-way bound value. |
| `label` | `string` |  |  |
| `accept` | `string` |  | Same syntax as the input's `accept`: ".png", "image/*", "image/png". |
| `maxSize` | `number` |  | Largest file in bytes. |
| `maxFiles` | `number` |  | Most files in the list. Extra ones are rejected with a reason, whether picked or dropped. |
| `hint` | `string` |  |  |
| `error` | `string` |  |  |
| `required` | `boolean` |  |  |
| `optional` | `boolean` |  |  |
| `multiple` | `boolean` | `true` |  |
| `progress` | `Record<string, number>` |  | Upload progress per file name, 0-100. A file without an entry shows no bar. |

Events: `reject`.

## Usage

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { reactive, ref, watch } from 'vue'
import FileUpload from '@/components/ui/file-upload.vue'

const files = ref<File[]>([])
const progress = reactive<Record<string, number>>({})
const avatar = ref<File[]>([])

// Pretend to upload: each new file fills up over a couple of seconds.
watch(files, (list) => {
  for (const f of list) {
    if (f.name in progress) continue
    progress[f.name] = 0
    const timer = setInterval(() => {
      progress[f.name] = Math.min(100, (progress[f.name] ?? 0) + 8 + Math.random() * 10)
      if (progress[f.name]! >= 100) clearInterval(timer)
    }, 250)
  }
})
</script>

<template>
  <div class="grid items-start gap-8 md:grid-cols-2">
    <FileUpload v-model="files" label="Attachments" accept=".png,.jpg,.pdf" :max-size="2 * 1024 * 1024" :max-files="3" :progress="progress" hint="Drop a 4th file, a .txt or one over 2 MB to see it refused." />
    <FileUpload v-model="avatar" label="Profile picture" accept="image/*" :max-size="500 * 1024" :multiple="false" required />
  </div>
</template>
```

## Rules

- Style it through theme tokens, not classes: sui has one design per component and no variants. `tone` exists only on status components.
- You own the copy: edit the file if the design must change.


---

# Dialog

Modal dialog with focus trap and scroll lock.

Group: Overlays. Registry item: http://localhost:5173/r/dialog.json

## Install

```sh
bunx shadcn-vue@latest add http://localhost:5173/r/dialog.json
```

Installs with: theme, utils. npm packages: reka-ui.

Import it from your own copy: `import Dialog from '@/components/ui/dialog.vue'`.

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `v-model:open` | `boolean` | `false` | Two-way bound value. |
| `title (required)` | `string` |  |  |
| `description` | `string` |  |  |
| `dismissible` | `boolean` | `true` | false: Escape and outside clicks do nothing and the corner X is hidden; the footer must offer the way out. |

Slots: `trigger`, `default`, `footer`.

## Usage

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref } from 'vue'
import Button from '@/components/ui/button.vue'
import Dialog from '@/components/ui/dialog.vue'
import TextField from '@/components/ui/text-field.vue'

const inviteOpen = ref(false)
const email = ref('')
const sent = ref('')
function send() {
  sent.value = email.value || 'nobody yet'
  inviteOpen.value = false
  email.value = ''
}
const terms = Array.from({ length: 12 }, (_, i) => `Clause ${i + 1}. The parties agree to keep their code open and their tokens consistent.`)
const forcedOpen = ref(false)
</script>

<template>
  <div class="grid gap-8">
    <div class="flex flex-col items-start gap-3">
      <span class="kicker">A message</span>
      <Dialog title="Delete project?" description="This can't be undone.">
        <template #trigger><Button>Open dialog</Button></template>
        All of the project's files and history will be permanently removed.
      </Dialog>
    </div>
    <div class="flex flex-col items-start gap-3">
      <span class="kicker">A form, focus starts in the field · last invite: {{ sent || 'none' }}</span>
      <Dialog v-model:open="inviteOpen" title="Invite a teammate" description="They'll get an email with a link.">
        <template #trigger><Button>Invite teammate</Button></template>
        <TextField v-model="email" label="Email" type="email" placeholder="name@company.com" data-autofocus />
        <template #footer><Button @click="send">Send invite</Button></template>
      </Dialog>
    </div>
    <div class="flex flex-col items-start gap-3">
      <span class="kicker">Long content scrolls inside; not dismissible variant below</span>
      <div class="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
        <Dialog title="Terms of use" description="Please read to the end.">
          <template #trigger><Button>Read the terms</Button></template>
          <p v-for="t in terms" :key="t" class="pb-3 text-muted">{{ t }}</p>
        </Dialog>
        <Dialog v-model:open="forcedOpen" title="Accept the terms" description="You need to choose to continue." :dismissible="false">
          <template #trigger><Button>Not dismissible</Button></template>
          Read the policy, then accept.
          <template #footer><Button @click="forcedOpen = false">I accept</Button></template>
        </Dialog>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</template>
```

## Rules

- Style it through theme tokens, not classes: sui has one design per component and no variants. `tone` exists only on status components.
- You own the copy: edit the file if the design must change.
