# Sheet

Side panel built on the dialog primitive.

Group: Overlays. Registry item: http://localhost:5173/r/sheet.json

## Install

```sh
bunx shadcn-vue@latest add http://localhost:5173/r/sheet.json
```

Installs with: theme, utils. npm packages: reka-ui.

Import it from your own copy: `import Sheet from '@/components/ui/sheet.vue'`.

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `v-model:open` | `boolean` | `false` | Two-way bound value. |
| `title (required)` | `string` |  |  |
| `description` | `string` |  |  |
| `side` | `'start' \| 'end'` | `'end'` | Which edge it opens from. Logical, so 'end' is the left edge in right-to-left pages. |
| `modal` | `boolean` | `true` | false: no overlay, the page behind stays usable and focus is not trapped. Close it with its X or Escape. |
| `dismissible` | `boolean` | `true` | false: Escape and outside clicks do nothing and the X is hidden. |

Slots: `trigger`, `default`, `footer`.

## Usage

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref } from 'vue'
import Button from '@/components/ui/button.vue'
import Checkbox from '@/components/ui/checkbox.vue'
import RadioGroup from '@/components/ui/radio-group.vue'
import Select from '@/components/ui/select.vue'
import Sheet from '@/components/ui/sheet.vue'
import Switch from '@/components/ui/switch.vue'
import TextField from '@/components/ui/text-field.vue'

const name = ref('Northwind')
const inspectorName = ref('Northwind')
const region = ref('eu')
const plan = ref('team')
const digest = ref(true)
const beta = ref(false)
const regions = [
  { value: 'us', label: 'United States' },
  { value: 'eu', label: 'Europe' },
  { value: 'ap', label: 'Asia Pacific' },
]
const plans = [
  { value: 'free', label: 'Free' },
  { value: 'team', label: 'Team' },
  { value: 'scale', label: 'Scale' },
]
const states = ['Open', 'In review', 'Blocked', 'Done', 'Archived']
const picked = ref<Record<string, boolean>>({ Open: true })
</script>

<template>
  <div class="grid gap-8">
    <div class="flex flex-col items-start gap-3">
      <span class="kicker">Settings panel</span>
      <Sheet title="Workspace settings" description="Changes save when you close.">
        <template #trigger><Button>Open settings</Button></template>
        <div class="grid gap-5">
          <TextField v-model="name" label="Workspace name" />
          <Select v-model="region" :options="regions" />
          <RadioGroup v-model="plan" :options="plans" />
          <Switch v-model="digest" label="Weekly digest" />
          <Switch v-model="beta" label="Join the beta" />
        </div>
      </Sheet>
    </div>
    <div class="flex flex-col items-start gap-3">
      <span class="kicker">Filters with a long list</span>
      <Sheet title="Filters" description="Narrow the results.">
        <template #trigger><Button>Open filters</Button></template>
        <div class="flex flex-col items-start gap-3">
          <Checkbox v-for="s in states" :key="s" v-model="picked[s]" :label="s" />
          <p class="pt-2 text-muted">Each filter narrows the list straight away.</p>
        </div>
      </Sheet>
    </div>
    <div class="flex flex-col items-start gap-3">
      <span class="kicker">From the start edge</span>
      <Sheet title="Navigation" description="Opens from the start side." side="start">
        <template #trigger><Button>Open from the start</Button></template>
        <p class="text-muted">Flips to the right edge in right-to-left pages.</p>
      </Sheet>
    </div>
    <div class="flex flex-col items-start gap-3">
      <span class="kicker">Non-modal: the page behind stays usable</span>
      <Sheet title="Inspector" description="No overlay, no focus trap." :modal="false">
        <template #trigger><Button>Open inspector</Button></template>
        <div class="grid gap-3">
          <p class="text-muted">Click elsewhere on the page: this stays open. Close it with its X or Escape.</p>
          <TextField v-model="inspectorName" label="Workspace name" />
        </div>
      </Sheet>
    </div>
  </div>
</template>
```

## Rules

- Style it through theme tokens, not classes: sui has one design per component and no variants. `tone` exists only on status components.
- You own the copy: edit the file if the design must change.

# Toggletip

A tooltip you click, for touch and screen readers. Focus stays on the button.

Group: Overlays. Registry item: http://localhost:5173/r/toggletip.json

## Install

```sh
bunx shadcn-vue@latest add http://localhost:5173/r/toggletip.json
```

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `v-model:open` | `boolean` | `false` | Two-way bound value. |
| `content (required)` | `string` |  |  |

Slots: `default`.

## Usage

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import Button from '@/components/ui/button.vue'
import Toggletip from '@/components/ui/toggletip.vue'
import Tooltip from '@/components/ui/tooltip.vue'

const info =
  'inline-grid size-7 cursor-pointer place-items-center rounded-full text-muted transition-state hover:text-ink focus-ring'
</script>

<template>
  <div class="grid gap-8">
    <div class="grid gap-3">
      <span class="kicker">Click the icon; Esc or a click outside closes it</span>
      <div class="flex items-center gap-1">
        <span>Billing period</span>
        <Toggletip content="Charged on the first of each month. Changing plans mid-month is prorated.">
          <button type="button" aria-label="About billing period" :class="info">
            <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" class="size-5" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.75" stroke-linecap="round" aria-hidden="true">
              <circle cx="12" cy="12" r="9" />
              <path d="M12 11v5M12 7.9h.01" />
            </svg>
          </button>
        </Toggletip>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="grid max-w-md gap-2">
      <span class="kicker">Versus a tooltip</span>
      <p class="text-muted">
        A tooltip opens on hover and focus, so touch users never see it. Use a toggletip when the text matters, or the
        screen is touch.
      </p>
      <div><Tooltip content="Hover or focus only"><Button>Tooltip</Button></Tooltip></div>
    </div>
  </div>
</template>
```

# Dropdown menu

Menu of actions with arrow-key navigation.

Group: Overlays. Registry item: http://localhost:5173/r/dropdown-menu.json

## Install

```sh
bunx shadcn-vue@latest add http://localhost:5173/r/dropdown-menu.json
```

Installs with: theme, utils. npm packages: reka-ui.

Import it from your own copy: `import Dropdownmenu from '@/components/ui/dropdown-menu.vue'`.

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `items (required)` | `{ value: string; label: string; disabled?: boolean; shortcut?: string }[]` |  | `shortcut` is a hint at the end of the row (it does not bind the key). |

Events: `select`.

Slots: `trigger`.

## Usage

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref } from 'vue'
import Button from '@/components/ui/button.vue'
import DropdownMenu from '@/components/ui/dropdown-menu.vue'

const picked = ref('nothing yet')
const items = [
  { value: 'rename', label: 'Rename', shortcut: 'F2' },
  { value: 'duplicate', label: 'Duplicate', shortcut: 'Ctrl D' },
  { value: 'archive', label: 'Archive' },
  { value: 'delete', label: 'Delete', disabled: true },
]
const longer = Array.from({ length: 12 }, (_, i) => ({ value: `ws-${i + 1}`, label: `Workspace ${i + 1}` }))
</script>

<template>
  <div class="grid gap-8">
    <div class="flex flex-col items-start gap-3">
      <span class="kicker">Actions · you picked: {{ picked }}</span>
      <DropdownMenu :items="items" @select="picked = $event">
        <template #trigger><Button>Actions</Button></template>
      </DropdownMenu>
    </div>
    <div class="flex flex-col items-start gap-3">
      <span class="kicker">A long list scrolls with the arrow keys</span>
      <DropdownMenu :items="longer" @select="picked = $event">
        <template #trigger><Button>Switch workspace</Button></template>
      </DropdownMenu>
    </div>
  </div>
</template>
```

## Rules

- Style it through theme tokens, not classes: sui has one design per component and no variants. `tone` exists only on status components.
- You own the copy: edit the file if the design must change.

# Alert dialog

Modal that demands a decision, for confirming destructive actions.

Group: Overlays. Registry item: http://localhost:5173/r/alert-dialog.json

## Install

```sh
bunx shadcn-vue@latest add http://localhost:5173/r/alert-dialog.json
```

Installs with: theme, utils. npm packages: reka-ui.

Import it from your own copy: `import Alertdialog from '@/components/ui/alert-dialog.vue'`.

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `v-model:open` | `boolean` | `false` | Two-way bound value. |
| `title (required)` | `string` |  |  |
| `description` | `string` |  |  |
| `confirmLabel` | `string` | `'Delete'` |  |
| `cancelLabel` | `string` | `'Cancel'` |  |
| `loading` | `boolean` |  | The confirmed action is running: the button shows busy, ignores presses, and the dialog stays open until you set this back to false. |
| `dismissible` | `boolean` | `true` | false: Escape does nothing, so the choice has to be made with a button. |

Events: `confirm`.

Slots: `trigger`, `default`.

## Usage

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref } from 'vue'
import AlertDialog from '@/components/ui/alert-dialog.vue'
import Button from '@/components/ui/button.vue'

const status = ref('Project is safe.')
const slowOpen = ref(false)
const working = ref(false)
const result = ref('not run')
function runSlow() {
  working.value = true
  setTimeout(() => {
    working.value = false
    result.value = 'deleted'
  }, 1800)
}
</script>

<template>
  <div class="grid gap-8">
    <div class="flex flex-col items-start gap-3">
      <span class="kicker">Destructive · {{ status }}</span>
      <AlertDialog
        title="Delete this project?"
        description="All files and history are permanently removed. This can't be undone."
        confirm-label="Delete project"
        @confirm="status = 'Project deleted.'"
      >
        <template #trigger><Button>Delete project</Button></template>
      </AlertDialog>
    </div>
    <div class="flex flex-col items-start gap-3">
      <span class="kicker">Slow action: stays open and busy until done · {{ result }}</span>
      <AlertDialog
        v-model:open="slowOpen"
        title="Delete 3,000 files?"
        description="This takes a moment and can't be undone."
        confirm-label="Delete files"
        :loading="working"
        @confirm="runSlow"
      >
        <template #trigger><Button>Delete files</Button></template>
      </AlertDialog>
    </div>
    <div class="flex flex-col items-start gap-3">
      <span class="kicker">Not dismissible: Escape does nothing</span>
      <AlertDialog title="Leave without saving?" description="Choose a button." confirm-label="Leave" cancel-label="Keep editing" :dismissible="false">
        <template #trigger><Button>Leave page</Button></template>
      </AlertDialog>
    </div>
  </div>
</template>
```

## Rules

- Style it through theme tokens, not classes: sui has one design per component and no variants. `tone` exists only on status components.
- You own the copy: edit the file if the design must change.


---

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
```

```vue
            <div class="grid gap-1">
              <p class="font-medium">Dame G</p>
              <p class="text-sm text-muted">Makes small tools and the sui component set.</p>
            </div>
          </div>
        </HoverCard>
        in the evenings.
      </p>
    </div>
    <div class="grid gap-3">
      <span class="kicker">A project</span>
      <p>
        Next up is
        <HoverCard>
          <template #trigger>
            <a href="#/components/hover-card" class="rounded-sm font-medium text-primary underline underline-offset-4 focus-ring">the Q4 launch</a>
          </template>
          <div class="grid gap-3">
            <div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2"><p class="font-medium">Q4 launch</p><Badge tone="warning">At risk</Badge></div>
            <Progress :model-value="58" label="Done" />
            <p class="text-sm text-muted">14 of 24 tasks complete. Due Dec 12.</p>
          </div>
        </HoverCard>
        and the website refresh.
      </p>
    </div>
  </div>
</template>
```

# Command

Command palette: ranked, highlighted matches, groups, icons, shortcuts, nested pages and a loading state.

Group: Overlays. Registry item: http://localhost:5173/r/command.json

## Install

```sh
bunx shadcn-vue@latest add http://localhost:5173/r/command.json
```

Installs with: theme, utils, announce, kbd, spinner. npm packages: reka-ui.

Import it from your own copy: `import Command from '@/components/ui/command.vue'`.

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `v-model:open` | `boolean` | `false` | Two-way bound value. |
| `items (required)` | `CommandItem[]` |  |  |
| `placeholder` | `string` | `'Type a command or search…'` |  |
| `empty` | `string` |  | The title of the empty state. Default: Nothing called “what you typed”. |
| `filter` | `(item: CommandItem, query: string) => boolean` |  | Your own matching (fuzzy, by keyword...). Default: every word of the query is found in the label, keywords or description, ignoring case and accents. |
| `loading` | `boolean` |  | Results are on their way: shows a busy row and sets aria-busy. |

Events: `select`.

## Usage

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { onBeforeUnmount, onMounted, ref, watch } from 'vue'
import Button from '@/components/ui/button.vue'
import Command, { type CommandItem } from '@/components/ui/command.vue'
import Kbd from '@/components/ui/kbd.vue'

const icon = {
  file: 'M14 3H7a2 2 0 0 0-2 2v14a2 2 0 0 0 2 2h10a2 2 0 0 0 2-2V8zM14 3v5h5',
  folder: 'M4 20h16a2 2 0 0 0 2-2V8a2 2 0 0 0-2-2h-7.9a2 2 0 0 1-1.7-.9l-.8-1.2A2 2 0 0 0 7.9 3H4a2 2 0 0 0-2 2v13c0 1.1.9 2 2 2Z',
  save: 'M19 21H5a2 2 0 0 1-2-2V5a2 2 0 0 1 2-2h11l5 5v11a2 2 0 0 1-2 2zM17 21v-8H7v8M7 3v5h8',
  search: 'M11 4a7 7 0 1 0 0 14 7 7 0 0 0 0-14zM20 20l-3.5-3.5',
  palette: 'M12 3a9 9 0 1 0 0 18c1.1 0 2-.9 2-2 0-.5-.2-1-.5-1.3-.3-.3-.5-.8-.5-1.3 0-1.1.9-2 2-2h2.3A4.7 4.7 0 0 0 22 11.7C22 6.9 17.5 3 12 3z',
  home: 'm3 11 9-8 9 8M5 10v10h14V10',
  sliders: 'M4 6h10M18 6h2M4 12h4M12 12h8M4 18h12M20 18h0M14 4v4M8 10v4M16 16v4',
}

const ran = ref('nothing yet')
const open = ref(false)
const items: CommandItem[] = [
  { value: 'new-file', label: 'New file', group: 'File', icon: icon.file, description: 'Start an empty document', shortcut: ['Ctrl', 'N'] },
  { value: 'open-file', label: 'Open file…', group: 'File', icon: icon.folder, shortcut: ['Ctrl', 'O'] },
  { value: 'save', label: 'Save', group: 'File', icon: icon.save, shortcut: ['Ctrl', 'S'] },
  { value: 'find', label: 'Find in files', group: 'Edit', icon: icon.search, keywords: ['search', 'grep'], shortcut: ['Ctrl', 'F'] },
  {
    value: 'theme',
    label: 'Change theme',
    group: 'View',
    icon: icon.palette,
    description: 'Light, dark or high contrast',
    children: [
      { value: 'theme-light', label: 'Light' },
      { value: 'theme-dark', label: 'Dark' },
      { value: 'theme-contrast', label: 'High contrast', description: 'Full-strength edges' },
    ],
  },
  { value: 'home', label: 'Go to home', group: 'Go to', icon: icon.home },
  { value: 'settings', label: 'Go to settings', group: 'Go to', icon: icon.sliders },
  { value: 'export', label: 'Export as PDF', group: 'File', disabled: true, description: 'Needs a saved file' },
]

// A second palette whose results arrive late.
const remoteOpen = ref(false)
const loading = ref(false)
const remote = ref<CommandItem[]>([])
watch(remoteOpen, (o) => {
  if (!o) return
  remote.value = []
  loading.value = true
  setTimeout(() => {
    remote.value = ['Button', 'Dialog', 'Data table', 'Date picker', 'Dropdown menu'].map((t) => ({ value: t, label: t, group: 'Components', description: 'sui registry' }))
    loading.value = false
  }, 900)
})

function onKey(e: KeyboardEvent) {
  if (e.key === 'j' && (e.metaKey || e.ctrlKey)) {
    e.preventDefault()
    open.value = !open.value
  }
}
onMounted(() => window.addEventListener('keydown', onKey))
onBeforeUnmount(() => window.removeEventListener('keydown', onKey))
</script>

<template>
  <div class="grid gap-6">
    <div class="grid gap-3">
      <span class="kicker">Groups, icons, shortcuts, a nested page and a disabled item</span>
      <div class="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-4">
        <Button @click="open = true">Open palette</Button>
        <span class="flex items-center gap-2 text-muted">or <Kbd>Ctrl</Kbd> <Kbd>J</Kbd></span>
        <span class="text-muted">Ran: <span class="numeral text-ink">{{ ran }}</span></span>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="grid gap-3">
      <span class="kicker">Results that arrive late</span>
      <div><Button @click="remoteOpen = true">Search the registry</Button></div>
    </div>
    <Command v-model:open="open" :items="items" @select="ran = $event" />
    <Command v-model:open="remoteOpen" :items="remote" :loading="loading" placeholder="Search components…" />
  </div>
</template>
```

## Rules

- Style it through theme tokens, not classes: sui has one design per component and no variants. `tone` exists only on status components.
- You own the copy: edit the file if the design must change.


---

# Toast

Brief notification fired from code: duration, action button, keyed updates and a promise helper.

Group: Overlays. Registry item: http://localhost:5173/r/toast.json

## Install

```sh
bunx shadcn-vue@latest add http://localhost:5173/r/toast.json
```

Installs with: theme, utils. npm packages: reka-ui.

Import it from your own copy: `import Toast from '@/components/ui/toast.vue'`.

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `duration` | `number` | `5000` |  |

## Usage

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import Button from '@/components/ui/button.vue'
import { toast } from '@/components/ui/toast.vue'

const fakeUpload = () => new Promise<void>((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 1800))
</script>

<template>
  <div class="grid gap-8">
    <div class="flex flex-col gap-2">
      <p class="kicker">The five tones</p>
      <div class="flex flex-wrap gap-3">
        <Button @click="toast({ title: 'Copied to clipboard', tone: 'neutral' })">Neutral</Button>
        <Button @click="toast({ title: 'New version available', description: 'Reload to update.', tone: 'info' })">Info</Button>
        <Button @click="toast({ title: 'Saved', description: 'Your changes are live.', tone: 'success' })">Success</Button>
        <Button @click="toast({ title: 'Storage almost full', description: '92% of 5 GB used.', tone: 'warning' })">Warning</Button>
        <Button @click="toast({ title: 'Upload failed', description: 'Check your connection.', tone: 'danger' })">Danger</Button>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="flex flex-col gap-2">
      <p class="kicker">Options</p>
      <div class="flex flex-wrap gap-3">
        <Button @click="toast({ title: 'Message archived', tone: 'success', action: { label: 'Undo', onClick: () => toast({ title: 'Restored', tone: 'info' }) } })">With an action</Button>
        <Button @click="toast({ key: 'sync', title: 'Syncing…', description: new Date().toLocaleTimeString(), tone: 'info' })">Same key updates</Button>
        <Button @click="toast.promise(fakeUpload(), { loading: 'Uploading…', success: 'Uploaded', error: 'Upload failed' })">Follow a promise</Button>
      </div>
    </div>
    <p class="max-w-md text-muted">
      Call <code class="numeral">toast()</code> from anywhere; one <code class="numeral">&lt;Toaster /&gt;</code> mounted once in your app shows them.
      Danger toasts and toasts with an action stay until dismissed.
    </p>
  </div>
</template>
```

## Rules

- Style it through theme tokens, not classes: sui has one design per component and no variants. `tone` exists only on status components.
- You own the copy: edit the file if the design must change.


---

# Tabs

Switch between panels of related content, with optional counts and vertical layout.

Group: Navigation. Registry item: http://localhost:5173/r/tabs.json

## Install

```sh
bunx shadcn-vue@latest add http://localhost:5173/r/tabs.json
```

Installs with: theme, utils, announce. npm packages: reka-ui.

Import it from your own copy: `import Tabs from '@/components/ui/tabs.vue'`.

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `v-model` | `string` |  | Two-way bound value. |
| `tabs (required)` | `{ value: string; label: string; count?: number; disabled?: boolean }[]` |  | `count` shows a small number after the label (unread, open items...). |
| `orientation` | `'horizontal' \| 'vertical'` | `'horizontal'` |  |

Slots: `t.value`.

## Usage

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref } from 'vue'
import Switch from '@/components/ui/switch.vue'
import Tabs from '@/components/ui/tabs.vue'
import TextField from '@/components/ui/text-field.vue'

const current = ref('account')
const name = ref('Ada Lovelace')
const email = ref(true)
const tabs = [
  { value: 'account', label: 'Account' },
  { value: 'notifications', label: 'Notifications' },
  { value: 'billing', label: 'Billing' },
]
const inbox = ref('unread')
const counted = [
  { value: 'unread', label: 'Unread', count: 12 },
  { value: 'flagged', label: 'Flagged', count: 3 },
  { value: 'archived', label: 'Archived' },
  { value: 'spam', label: 'Spam', count: 0, disabled: true },
]
</script>

<template>
  <div class="grid gap-8">
    <div class="grid gap-3">
      <span class="kicker">With panels</span>
      <Tabs v-model="current" :tabs="tabs" class="max-w-lg">
        <template #account><TextField v-model="name" label="Display name" /></template>
        <template #notifications><Switch v-model="email" label="Email me weekly summaries" /></template>
        <template #billing><p class="text-muted">Team plan, 8 of 10 seats used.</p></template>
      </Tabs>
    </div>
    <div class="grid gap-3">
      <span class="kicker">Counts and a disabled tab</span>
      <Tabs v-model="inbox" :tabs="counted">
        <template #unread><p class="text-muted">12 unread messages.</p></template>
        <template #flagged><p class="text-muted">Messages you starred.</p></template>
        <template #archived><p class="text-muted">Archived mail.</p></template>
        <template #spam><p class="text-muted">Unavailable.</p></template>
      </Tabs>
    </div>
    <div class="grid gap-3">
      <span class="kicker">Vertical</span>
      <Tabs :tabs="tabs" orientation="vertical" class="max-w-lg">
        <template #account><p class="text-muted">Use the up and down arrow keys.</p></template>
        <template #notifications><p class="text-muted">What reaches your inbox.</p></template>
        <template #billing><p class="text-muted">Plan and invoices.</p></template>
      </Tabs>
    </div>
  </div>
</template>
```

## Rules

- Style it through theme tokens, not classes: sui has one design per component and no variants. `tone` exists only on status components.
- You own the copy: edit the file if the design must change.

```vue
]

        <template #a>
          <p class="leading-normal">Panels can hold anything: text, a <Badge tone="success">Badge</Badge> and more.</p>
```

# Pagination

Page through long lists, with links or buttons and announced page changes.

Group: Navigation. Registry item: http://localhost:5173/r/pagination.json

## Install

```sh
bunx shadcn-vue@latest add http://localhost:5173/r/pagination.json
```

Installs with: theme, utils, announce. npm packages: reka-ui.

Import it from your own copy: `import Pagination from '@/components/ui/pagination.vue'`.

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `v-model:page` | `number` | `1` | Two-way bound value. |
| `total (required)` | `number` |  |  |
| `itemsPerPage` | `number` | `10` |  |
| `href` | `(page: number) => string` |  | Makes every page a real link (for server-rendered or router-driven pages). The model still updates on click. |

## Usage

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref } from 'vue'
import Pagination from '@/components/ui/pagination.vue'

const middle = ref(6)
const few = ref(2)
const linked = ref(3)
</script>

<template>
  <div class="grid gap-6">
    <div class="grid gap-2">
      <span class="kicker">Page {{ middle }} of 12</span>
      <Pagination v-model:page="middle" :total="120" :items-per-page="10" />
    </div>
    <div class="grid gap-2">
      <span class="kicker">Few pages</span>
      <Pagination v-model:page="few" :total="30" :items-per-page="10" />
    </div>
    <div class="grid gap-2">
      <span class="kicker">As links</span>
      <Pagination v-model:page="linked" :total="80" :items-per-page="10" :href="(n) => `#/components/pagination?page=${n}`" />
    </div>
  </div>
</template>
```

## Rules

- Style it through theme tokens, not classes: sui has one design per component and no variants. `tone` exists only on status components.
- You own the copy: edit the file if the design must change.

# Skip link

Hidden until focused; jumps the keyboard past the header to the main content.

Group: Navigation. Registry item: http://localhost:5173/r/skip-link.json

## Install

```sh
bunx shadcn-vue@latest add http://localhost:5173/r/skip-link.json
```

Installs with: theme, utils. npm packages: none beyond Vue.

Import it from your own copy: `import Skiplink from '@/components/ui/skip-link.vue'`.

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `to` | `string` | `'main'` |  |

Slots: `default`.

## Usage

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import SkipLink from '@/components/ui/skip-link.vue'
</script>

<template>
  <div class="grid max-w-xl gap-4">
    <p class="kicker">Click in this box, then press Tab</p>
    <div class="relative grid gap-3 rounded-md border border-edge p-4" tabindex="-1">
      <SkipLink to="skip-demo-target">Skip to the demo content</SkipLink>
      <nav aria-label="Demo" class="flex gap-4 text-muted"><span>Home</span><span>Docs</span><span>Pricing</span></nav>
      <div id="skip-demo-target" tabindex="-1" class="rounded-sm bg-surface-tint p-3 outline-none focus:outline-2 focus:outline-primary">Main content: focus lands here.</div>
    </div>
    <p class="text-muted">Put it first in the page. It stays hidden until the keyboard reaches it. This site uses one too.</p>
  </div>
</template>
```

## Rules

- Style it through theme tokens, not classes: sui has one design per component and no variants. `tone` exists only on status components.
- You own the copy: edit the file if the design must change.

# Nav list

List of links or buttons with an active slab, vertical or horizontal. The first letter of each item is strong.

Group: Navigation. Registry item: http://localhost:5173/r/nav-list.json

## Install

```sh
bunx shadcn-vue@latest add http://localhost:5173/r/nav-list.json
```

Installs with: theme, utils. npm packages: none beyond Vue.

Import it from your own copy: `import Navlist from '@/components/ui/nav-list.vue'`.

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `v-model` | `string` | `''` | Two-way bound value. |
| `sections (required)` | `NavSection[]` |  |  |
| `orientation` | `'vertical' \| 'horizontal'` | `'vertical'` |  |
| `flush` | `boolean` |  | Vertical only: the current row runs out to the container's end edge instead of stopping at its padding, like a marker on a page's margin. |
| `label` | `string` |  |  |

## Usage

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref } from 'vue'
import Card from '@/components/ui/card.vue'
import NavList from '@/components/ui/nav-list.vue'

const side = ref('overview')
const top = ref('overview')
const marker = ref('activity')
const inContext = ref('profile')
const sections = [
  { items: [{ value: 'overview', label: 'Overview' }, { value: 'activity', label: 'Activity' }] },
  { title: 'Workspace', items: [{ value: 'projects', label: 'Projects' }, { value: 'members', label: 'Members' }, { value: 'billing', label: 'Billing' }] },
]
const settings = [
  { title: 'Account', items: [{ value: 'profile', label: 'Profile' }, { value: 'security', label: 'Security' }, { value: 'notifications', label: 'Notifications' }] },
  { title: 'Team', items: [{ value: 'people', label: 'People' }, { value: 'roles', label: 'Roles' }] },
]
const copy: Record<string, string> = {
  profile: 'Your name, photo and the address people reach you on.',
  security: 'Passwords, two-factor codes and active sessions.',
  notifications: 'Choose what lands in your inbox, and when.',
  people: 'Invite teammates and remove access.',
  roles: 'Decide who can edit, review or only read.',
}
</script>

<template>
  <div class="grid gap-8">
    <div class="grid gap-3">
      <span class="kicker">Vertical, with sections · {{ side }}</span>
      <div class="max-w-64 overflow-hidden rounded-md shadow-frame"><NavList v-model="side" :sections="sections" /></div>
    </div>
    <div class="grid gap-3">
      <span class="kicker">Flush: the current row runs to the edge · {{ marker }}</span>
      <div class="max-w-64 overflow-hidden rounded-md shadow-frame"><NavList v-model="marker" flush :sections="sections" /></div>
    </div>
    <div class="grid gap-3">
      <span class="kicker">Horizontal · {{ top }}</span>
      <div class="overflow-hidden rounded-md shadow-frame"><NavList v-model="top" :sections="sections" orientation="horizontal" /></div>
    </div>
    <div class="grid gap-3">
      <span class="kicker">In a settings page</span>
      <div class="flex flex-col items-start gap-4 md:flex-row">
        <div class="w-full overflow-hidden rounded-md shadow-frame md:w-64 md:shrink-0"><NavList v-model="inContext" :sections="settings" /></div>
        <Card :title="inContext[0]!.toUpperCase() + inContext.slice(1)" class="w-full md:flex-1"><p class="text-muted">{{ copy[inContext] }}</p></Card>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</template>
```

## Rules

- Style it through theme tokens, not classes: sui has one design per component and no variants. `tone` exists only on status components.
- You own the copy: edit the file if the design must change.

# Menubar

Row of menus, like an app menu bar.

Group: Navigation. Registry item: http://localhost:5173/r/menubar.json

## Install

```sh
bunx shadcn-vue@latest add http://localhost:5173/r/menubar.json
```

Installs with: theme, utils. npm packages: reka-ui.

Import it from your own copy: `import Menubar from '@/components/ui/menubar.vue'`.

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `menus (required)` | `{ value: string; label: string; items: { value: string; label: string; disabled?: boolean; shortcut?: string }[] }[]` |  |  |

Events: `select`.

## Usage

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref } from 'vue'
import Menubar from '@/components/ui/menubar.vue'

const last = ref('nothing yet')
const menus = [
  { value: 'file', label: 'File', items: [{ value: 'new', label: 'New file' }, { value: 'open', label: 'Open…' }, { value: 'save', label: 'Save' }, { value: 'export', label: 'Export as PDF' }] },
  { value: 'edit', label: 'Edit', items: [{ value: 'undo', label: 'Undo' }, { value: 'redo', label: 'Redo' }, { value: 'cut', label: 'Cut' }, { value: 'copy', label: 'Copy' }, { value: 'paste', label: 'Paste', disabled: true }] },
  { value: 'view', label: 'View', items: [{ value: 'zoom-in', label: 'Zoom in' }, { value: 'zoom-out', label: 'Zoom out' }, { value: 'full', label: 'Full screen' }] },
  { value: 'window', label: 'Window', items: [{ value: 'min', label: 'Minimise' }, { value: 'tile', label: 'Tile left' }] },
  { value: 'help', label: 'Help', items: [{ value: 'docs', label: 'Documentation' }, { value: 'about', label: 'About sui' }] },
]
const small = menus.slice(0, 2)
</script>

<template>
  <div class="grid gap-8">
    <div class="grid gap-3">
      <span class="kicker">App menu bar · {{ last }}</span>
      <Menubar :menus="menus" @select="(m, i) => (last = `${m} / ${i}`)" />
      <p class="max-w-md text-sm text-muted">Open one menu, then move across the bar with the arrow keys to switch menus.</p>
    </div>
    <div class="grid gap-3">
      <span class="kicker">Two menus only</span>
      <Menubar :menus="small" @select="(m, i) => (last = `${m} / ${i}`)" />
    </div>
  </div>
</template>
```

## Rules

- Style it through theme tokens, not classes: sui has one design per component and no variants. `tone` exists only on status components.
- You own the copy: edit the file if the design must change.

# Stepper

Steps through a multi-step flow: interactive or read-only, horizontal or vertical, with error and done states.

Group: Navigation. Registry item: http://localhost:5173/r/stepper.json

## Install

```sh
bunx shadcn-vue@latest add http://localhost:5173/r/stepper.json
```

Installs with: theme, utils, announce. npm packages: reka-ui.

Import it from your own copy: `import Stepper from '@/components/ui/stepper.vue'`.

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `v-model` | `number` | `1` | Two-way bound value. |
| `steps (required)` | `{ value: number; title: string; description?: string; error?: boolean }[]` |  |  |
| `interactive` | `boolean` | `true` | Steps are buttons you can jump to. Off: they only show where you are, and your own Next/Back move on. |
| `orientation` | `'horizontal' \| 'vertical'` | `'horizontal'` |  |

## Usage

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref } from 'vue'
import Button from '@/components/ui/button.vue'
import Notice from '@/components/ui/notice.vue'
import RadioGroup from '@/components/ui/radio-group.vue'
import Stepper from '@/components/ui/stepper.vue'
import TextField from '@/components/ui/text-field.vue'

const step = ref(2)
const name = ref('Grace Hopper')
const plan = ref('team')
const steps = [
  { value: 1, title: 'Account', description: 'Your details' },
  { value: 2, title: 'Plan', description: 'Pick a tier' },
  { value: 3, title: 'Done' },
]
const plans = [
  { value: 'solo', label: 'Solo: one project' },
  { value: 'team', label: 'Team: unlimited projects' },
]
const withError = [{ value: 1, title: 'Account' }, { value: 2, title: 'Plan', error: true }, { value: 3, title: 'Payment' }]
const vstep = ref(2)
</script>

<template>
  <div class="grid gap-10 overflow-x-auto">
    <div class="grid gap-5">
      <span class="kicker">A flow</span>
      <Stepper v-model="step" :steps="steps" />
      <div class="grid max-w-md gap-4">
        <TextField v-if="step === 1" v-model="name" label="Full name" />
        <RadioGroup v-else-if="step === 2" v-model="plan" :options="plans" />
        <Notice v-else tone="success" title="You're all set">Welcome aboard, {{ name }}.</Notice>
      </div>
      <div class="flex gap-2">
        <Button :disabled="step === 1" @click="step--">Back</Button>
        <Button :disabled="step === steps.length" @click="step++">Next</Button>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="grid gap-3">
      <span class="kicker">An error on a step</span>
      <Stepper :model-value="3" :steps="withError" />
    </div>
    <div class="grid gap-3">
      <span class="kicker">Vertical</span>
      <Stepper v-model="vstep" :steps="steps" orientation="vertical" />
    </div>
  </div>
</template>
```

## Rules

- Style it through theme tokens, not classes: sui has one design per component and no variants. `tone` exists only on status components.
- You own the copy: edit the file if the design must change.


---

# Toolbar

Grouped buttons and toggles with roving keyboard focus.

Group: Navigation. Registry item: http://localhost:5173/r/toolbar.json

## Install

```sh
bunx shadcn-vue@latest add http://localhost:5173/r/toolbar.json
```

Installs with: theme, utils. npm packages: reka-ui.

Import it from your own copy: `import Toolbar from '@/components/ui/toolbar.vue'`.

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `v-model:pressed` | `string[]` | `[]` | Two-way bound value. |
| `items (required)` | `ToolbarItem[]` |  |  |
| `label` | `string` |  |  |

Events: `action`.

Slots: `seg.item.value ?? ''`, `t.value ?? ''`.

## Usage

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref } from 'vue'
import Textarea from '@/components/ui/textarea.vue'
import Toolbar, { type ToolbarItem } from '@/components/ui/toolbar.vue'

const format = ref<string[]>(['bold'])
const align = ref<string[]>(['left'])
const last = ref('nothing yet')
const text = ref('Select some text and use the toolbar above.')

const formatting: ToolbarItem[] = [
  { type: 'toggle', value: 'bold', label: 'Bold' },
  { type: 'toggle', value: 'italic', label: 'Italic' },
  { type: 'toggle', value: 'underline', label: 'Underline' },
  { type: 'separator' },
  { type: 'toggle', value: 'left', label: 'Left' },
  { type: 'toggle', value: 'center', label: 'Centre' },
  { type: 'toggle', value: 'right', label: 'Right' },
  { type: 'separator' },
  { type: 'button', value: 'undo', label: 'Undo' },
  { type: 'button', value: 'redo', label: 'Redo' },
]
const clipboard: ToolbarItem[] = [
  { type: 'button', value: 'cut', label: 'Cut' },
  { type: 'button', value: 'copy', label: 'Copy' },
  { type: 'button', value: 'paste', label: 'Paste' },
]
</script>

<template>
  <div class="grid gap-8">
    <div class="grid gap-3">
      <span class="kicker">An editor toolbar · last action: {{ last }}</span>
      <Toolbar v-model:pressed="format" :items="formatting.slice(0, 3)" label="Text style" @action="last = $event">
        <template #bold><span class="font-strong">B</span></template>
        <template #italic><span class="italic">I</span></template>
        <template #underline><span class="underline">U</span></template>
      </Toolbar>
      <Toolbar v-model:pressed="align" :items="formatting.slice(4)" label="Alignment and history" @action="last = $event" />
      <Textarea v-model="text" label="Document" />
    </div>
    <div class="grid gap-3">
      <span class="kicker">Buttons only</span>
      <Toolbar :items="clipboard" label="Clipboard" @action="last = $event" />
    </div>
  </div>
</template>
```

## Rules

- Style it through theme tokens, not classes: sui has one design per component and no variants. `tone` exists only on status components.
- You own the copy: edit the file if the design must change.

# Tree

Expandable hierarchy for files and categories.

Group: Navigation. Registry item: http://localhost:5173/r/tree.json

## Install

```sh
bunx shadcn-vue@latest add http://localhost:5173/r/tree.json
```

Installs with: theme, utils. npm packages: reka-ui.

Import it from your own copy: `import Tree from '@/components/ui/tree.vue'`.

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `v-model` | `string` |  | Two-way bound value. |
| `items (required)` | `TreeNode[]` |  |  |
| `defaultExpanded` | `string[]` |  |  |
| `toggleOn` | `'row' \| 'chevron'` | `'row'` | What opens a folder: a click anywhere on its row, or only its chevron (then the row just selects). Arrow keys always work. |

## Usage

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref } from 'vue'
import Tree, { type TreeNode } from '@/components/ui/tree.vue'

const file = ref('button.vue')
const chevronPick = ref('phones')
const files: TreeNode[] = [
  {
    value: 'src',
    label: 'src',
    children: [
      {
        value: 'components',
        label: 'components',
        children: [
          { value: 'button.vue', label: 'button.vue' },
          { value: 'dialog.vue', label: 'dialog.vue' },
          { value: 'tree.vue', label: 'tree.vue' },
        ],
      },
      { value: 'lib', label: 'lib', children: [{ value: 'utils.ts', label: 'utils.ts' }] },
      { value: 'main.ts', label: 'main.ts' },
    ],
  },
  { value: 'public', label: 'public', children: [{ value: 'favicon.svg', label: 'favicon.svg' }] },
  { value: 'package.json', label: 'package.json' },
  { value: 'README.md', label: 'README.md' },
]
const store: TreeNode[] = [
  {
    value: 'electronics',
    label: 'Electronics',
    children: [
      { value: 'phones', label: 'Phones' },
      { value: 'laptops', label: 'Laptops' },
      { value: 'audio', label: 'Audio', children: [{ value: 'headphones', label: 'Headphones' }, { value: 'speakers', label: 'Speakers' }] },
    ],
  },
  { value: 'home', label: 'Home', children: [{ value: 'kitchen', label: 'Kitchen' }, { value: 'garden', label: 'Garden' }] },
  { value: 'books', label: 'Books' },
]
</script>

<template>
  <div class="grid gap-8 md:grid-cols-2">
    <div class="grid content-start gap-3">
      <span class="kicker">Files · {{ file }}</span>
      <div class="max-w-xs overflow-hidden rounded-md shadow-frame">
        <Tree v-model="file" :items="files" :default-expanded="['src', 'components']" />
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="grid content-start gap-3">
      <span class="kicker">Toggle on the chevron only · {{ chevronPick }}</span>
      <div class="max-w-xs overflow-hidden rounded-md shadow-frame">
        <Tree v-model="chevronPick" :items="store" toggle-on="chevron" :default-expanded="['electronics']" />
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</template>
```

## Rules

- Style it through theme tokens, not classes: sui has one design per component and no variants. `tone` exists only on status components.
- You own the copy: edit the file if the design must change.

# Description list

Label and value rows, ruled apart, for facts about one thing.

Group: Data. Registry item: http://localhost:5173/r/description-list.json

## Install

```sh
bunx shadcn-vue@latest add http://localhost:5173/r/description-list.json
```

Installs with: theme, utils, badge. npm packages: none beyond Vue.

Import it from your own copy: `import Descriptionlist from '@/components/ui/description-list.vue'`.

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `items (required)` | `(DescriptionItem \| null \| undefined)[]` |  |  |
| `empty` | `string` |  | Message when there are no rows. |
| `loading` | `boolean` |  |  |
| `as` | `'dl' \| 'ul'` |  | `dl` for label and value pairs, `ul` for plain facts. Defaults to `ul` when no row has a label. |

Events: `action`.

Slots: `text`, `action`.

## Usage

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref } from 'vue'
import Button from '@/components/ui/button.vue'
import Card from '@/components/ui/card.vue'
import DescriptionList from '@/components/ui/description-list.vue'

const contact = [
  { label: 'Name', text: 'Grace Hopper' },
  { label: 'Email', text: 'grace@example.com', badge: 'Verified', badgeTone: 'success' as const, action: 'Edit' },
  { label: 'Phone', text: '+1 202 555 0143', badge: 'Unconfirmed', badgeTone: 'warning' as const },
  { label: 'Billing address', text: '1 Hopper Way, Arlington VA', action: 'Edit' },
]
const facts = [{ text: 'Statement covers 12 September' }, { text: 'Due 31 October', badge: 'In 9 days', badgeTone: 'info' as const }, { text: 'Paid in full', badge: 'Settled', badgeTone: 'success' as const }]
const editing = ref('')
</script>

<template>
  <div class="grid gap-6 md:grid-cols-2">
    <Card title="Billing contact" class="md:col-span-2">
      <DescriptionList :items="contact" @action="(item) => (editing = item.label ?? '')" />
      <p class="mt-3 text-muted">{{ editing ? `Editing ${editing}` : 'Click an Edit action: it fires an event.' }}</p>
    </Card>
    <Card title="Plain facts"><DescriptionList :items="facts" /></Card>
    <Card title="Action slot">
      <DescriptionList :items="contact.slice(0, 2)">
        <template #action><Button>Copy</Button></template>
      </DescriptionList>
    </Card>
    <Card title="Loading"><DescriptionList :items="[]" loading /></Card>
    <Card title="Empty"><DescriptionList :items="[]" empty="No details yet." /></Card>
  </div>
</template>
```

## Rules

- Style it through theme tokens, not classes: sui has one design per component and no variants. `tone` exists only on status components.
- You own the copy: edit the file if the design must change.


---

# Carousel

Scroll-snapping slides with previous, next and dots.

Group: Data. Registry item: http://localhost:5173/r/carousel.json

## Install

```sh
bunx shadcn-vue@latest add http://localhost:5173/r/carousel.json
```

Installs with: theme, utils. npm packages: none beyond Vue.

Import it from your own copy: `import Carousel from '@/components/ui/carousel.vue'`.

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `v-model:index` | `number` | `0` | Two-way bound value. |
| `perView` | `number` | `1` | Slides shown at once, at most: fewer are shown when the track is too narrow for `minWidth`. |
| `gap` | `number` | `1` | Space between slides, in rem. |
| `minWidth` | `number` | `14` | The narrowest a slide may get before the carousel shows fewer at once, in rem. |
| `label` | `string` |  |  |

## Usage

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref } from 'vue'
import Badge from '@/components/ui/badge.vue'
import Button from '@/components/ui/button.vue'
import Card from '@/components/ui/card.vue'
import Carousel from '@/components/ui/carousel.vue'

const hero = ref(0)
const slides = [
  { tone: 'bg-primary text-on-primary', badge: 'Own', title: 'Own the source', text: 'Every component is a file in your repo. Change the file and you have changed the component.' },
  { tone: 'bg-info-soft text-ink', badge: 'Theme', title: 'Theme the tokens', text: 'Brand, radius, depth and font are the only knobs. Contrast is checked as you turn them.' },
  { tone: 'bg-success-soft text-ink', badge: 'Lint', title: 'Lint the rules', text: 'A preset for @shadcn/lint keeps pages positioning components rather than restyling them.' },
  { tone: 'bg-warning-soft text-ink', badge: 'Reka', title: 'Accessible by default', text: 'Focus, keyboard and dismissal come from Reka UI, so the behaviour is not yours to maintain.' },
  { tone: 'bg-surface-tint text-ink', badge: 'Slab', title: 'One distinct look', text: 'Raised faces sit on a darker slab, and tone edges are slabs turned on their side.' },
]
const cards = ['Overview', 'Activity', 'Members', 'Billing', 'Settings', 'Audit log']
</script>

<template>
  <div class="grid gap-10">
    <!-- A hero: one slide at a time, the first slide in view is v-model. -->
    <div class="grid gap-2">
      <Carousel v-model:index="hero" label="What sui gives you">
        <div v-for="s in slides" :key="s.title" :class="['flex min-h-56 flex-col items-start justify-end gap-3 rounded-md p-8 shadow-frame', s.tone]">
          <Badge>{{ s.badge }}</Badge>
          <h3 class="heading text-3xl">{{ s.title }}</h3>
          <p class="max-w-md leading-normal">{{ s.text }}</p>
        </div>
      </Carousel>
      <p class="text-sm text-muted">Slide {{ hero + 1 }} of {{ slides.length }}. Arrow keys, dots, drag or swipe.</p>
    </div>

    <!-- Several at once: three on a wide track, fewer when it narrows. -->
    <Carousel :per-view="3" label="Workspace sections">
      <Card v-for="c in cards" :key="c" :title="c">
        <p class="text-muted">The {{ c.toLowerCase() }} for this workspace.</p>
        <div><Button>Open</Button></div>
      </Card>
    </Carousel>

  </div>
</template>
```

## Rules

- Style it through theme tokens, not classes: sui has one design per component and no variants. `tone` exists only on status components.
- You own the copy: edit the file if the design must change.


---

# Chart

Line, area and bar charts drawn in SVG from the theme tokens.

Group: Data. Registry item: http://localhost:5173/r/chart.json

## Install

```sh
bunx shadcn-vue@latest add http://localhost:5173/r/chart.json
```

Installs with: theme, utils. npm packages: none beyond Vue.

Import it from your own copy: `import Chart from '@/components/ui/chart.vue'`.

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `type` | `'line' \| 'area' \| 'bar'` | `'line'` | What is being shown, not a look: every type uses the same drawing language. |
| `categories (required)` | `string[]` |  |  |
| `series (required)` | `ChartSeries[]` |  |  |
| `height` | `number` | `undefined` | Pixel height of the plot; the width is the container's. Defaults to 280, or 48 for a sparkline. |
| `stacked` | `boolean` | `false` | Stack bars and areas on top of each other instead of side by side / overlapping. Positive and negative values stack away from zero on their own sides. |
| `format` | `(value: number) => string` |  | Formats a value for the axis, the tooltip and the screen-reader table. |
| `unit` | `string` |  | Appended to the default number format (`%`, ` ms`). Ignored when `format` is set. |
| `min` | `number` |  | Fix the bottom or top of the value axis. A line may float above zero; bars and areas always include it. |
| `max` | `number` |  |  |
| `axes` | `boolean` | `true` | Draw the axes and gridlines. Off gives a bare line. |
| `sparkline` | `boolean` |  | A compact trend: just the line (or area) and its last point, no axes or legend. |
| `legend` | `boolean` | `undefined` | Show the legend (also the way to hide a series). Defaults to on for more than one series. |
| `loading` | `boolean` |  |  |
| `label` | `string` |  |  |

## Usage

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import Card from '@/components/ui/card.vue'
import Chart from '@/components/ui/chart.vue'

const months = ['Jan', 'Feb', 'Mar', 'Apr', 'May', 'Jun', 'Jul', 'Aug', 'Sep', 'Oct', 'Nov', 'Dec']
const money = (v: number) => `${v < 0 ? '-' : ''}$${new Intl.NumberFormat().format(Math.abs(v))}`

const growth = [
  { name: 'Visitors', data: [3200, 4100, 3800, 5200, 6100, 5800, 7200, 7900, 7600, 8800, 9400, 10600] },
  { name: 'Signups', data: [410, 620, 550, 880, 1010, 960, 1300, 1520, 1440, 1730, 1910, 2250] },
]
const cashflow = [
  { name: 'In', data: [8200, 9100, 8800, 10400, 11200, 12900] },
  { name: 'Out', data: [-6400, -7100, -9600, -7800, -8300, -9100] },
]
const uptime = [{ name: 'Uptime', data: [99.9, 99.95, 99.4, 99.99, 100, 99.8, 99.92, 99.97, 98.9, 99.96, 99.99, 100] }]

const trends = [
  { title: 'Signups', value: '2,250', data: [4, 6, 5, 8, 7, 9, 12, 10, 13, 15, 14, 18] },
  { title: 'Errors', value: '5', data: [18, 16, 17, 13, 14, 11, 12, 9, 8, 9, 6, 5] },
  { title: 'Latency', value: '184 ms', data: [210, 198, 205, 190, 201, 186, 192, 180, 188, 176, 181, 184] },
]
</script>

<template>
  <div class="grid gap-6 lg:grid-cols-2">
    <Card title="Growth" class="lg:col-span-2">
      <Chart type="line" :categories="months" :series="growth" label="Visitors and signups by month" />
    </Card>
    <Card title="Cash in and out">
      <Chart type="bar" stacked :categories="months.slice(0, 6)" :series="cashflow" :format="money" label="Money in and out by month" />
    </Card>
    <Card title="Uptime">
      <Chart type="area" :categories="months" :series="uptime" :min="98" :max="100" unit="%" :height="280" label="Uptime by month" />
    </Card>
    <Card title="Trends, loading, empty" class="lg:col-span-2">
      <div class="grid gap-6 sm:grid-cols-3">
        <div v-for="t in trends" :key="t.title" class="grid gap-1">
          <span class="kicker">{{ t.title }}</span>
          <span class="numeral text-3xl font-medium">{{ t.value }}</span>
          <Chart type="area" sparkline :categories="months" :series="[{ name: t.title, data: t.data }]" :label="`${t.title} over the year`" />
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="grid gap-6 sm:grid-cols-2">
        <Chart loading :categories="months" :series="growth" :height="96" />
        <Chart type="bar" :categories="[]" :series="[{ name: 'Orders', data: [] }]" :height="96" />
      </div>
    </Card>
  </div>
</template>
```

## Rules

- Style it through theme tokens, not classes: sui has one design per component and no variants. `tone` exists only on status components.
- You own the copy: edit the file if the design must change.


---

# List

One-tab-stop list with arrow keys and typeahead, for choosing a row or marking the current one.

Group: Data. Registry item: http://localhost:5173/r/list.json

## Install

```sh
bunx shadcn-vue@latest add http://localhost:5173/r/list.json
```

Installs with: theme, utils. npm packages: none beyond Vue.

Import it from your own copy: `import List from '@/components/ui/list.vue'`.

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `v-model` | `string` |  | Two-way bound value. |
| `items (required)` | `ListItem[]` |  |  |
| `label (required)` | `string` |  | Names the list for screen readers. |
| `mode` | `'select' \| 'current'` | `'select'` | `select` marks the chosen rows with a tick, like a choice. `current` marks the row you are in with the primary edge, like a place. |
| `followFocus` | `boolean` |  | Choosing follows the arrow keys, so moving is choosing. Without it, Enter or Space chooses. |
| `empty` | `string` |  | Message when there are no items. |
| `loading` | `boolean` |  |  |

Slots: `trailing`.

## Usage

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref } from 'vue'
import Badge from '@/components/ui/badge.vue'
import Card from '@/components/ui/card.vue'
import List from '@/components/ui/list.vue'

const threads = [
  { value: 'launch', title: 'Launch checklist', description: 'Ada: the docs still need a pass' },
  { value: 'budget', title: 'Budget review', description: 'Linus: numbers attached' },
  { value: 'offsite', title: 'Team offsite', description: 'Grace: dates are locked' },
  { value: 'hiring', title: 'Hiring plan', description: 'Alan: two roles open', disabled: true },
  { value: 'roadmap', title: 'Roadmap Q3', description: 'Margaret: draft v2' },
]
const plans = [
  { value: 'free', title: 'Free', description: '1 project' },
  { value: 'team', title: 'Team', description: '10 projects, shared themes' },
  { value: 'scale', title: 'Scale', description: 'Unlimited, priority support' },
]
const current = ref('budget')
const plan = ref('team')
const follow = ref('launch')
const unread: Record<string, number> = { launch: 3, offsite: 1 }
</script>

<template>
  <div class="grid gap-8 md:grid-cols-2">
    <Card title="Current place" class="md:row-span-2">
      <List v-model="current" label="Inbox" mode="current" :items="threads">
        <template #trailing="{ item }"><Badge v-if="unread[item.value]" tone="info">{{ unread[item.value] }}</Badge></template>
      </List>
      <p class="text-muted">Tab in once, then arrows, Home, End or type “bu”. Enter or Space chooses; the disabled row is skipped.</p>
    </Card>
    <Card title="Choosing one"><List v-model="plan" label="Plan" :items="plans" /></Card>
    <Card title="Follow focus"><List v-model="follow" label="Threads" follow-focus :items="threads.slice(0, 3)" /></Card>
    <Card title="Empty"><List label="Nothing" :items="[]" empty="No threads yet." /></Card>
    <Card title="Loading"><List label="Loading" :items="[]" loading /></Card>
  </div>
</template>
```

## Rules

- Style it through theme tokens, not classes: sui has one design per component and no variants. `tone` exists only on status components.
- You own the copy: edit the file if the design must change.


---

# Virtual list

Draws only the rows in view, for lists of tens of thousands of items.

Group: Data. Registry item: http://localhost:5173/r/virtual-list.json

## Install

```sh
bunx shadcn-vue@latest add http://localhost:5173/r/virtual-list.json
```

Installs with: theme, utils. npm packages: none beyond Vue.

Import it from your own copy: `import Virtuallist from '@/components/ui/virtual-list.vue'`.

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `items (required)` | `T[]` |  |  |
| `itemHeight` | `number` |  | Every row is exactly this tall (px). Leave it out and rows are measured as they are drawn, starting from `estimate`. |
| `estimate` | `number` | `48` |  |
| `height` | `string` | `'20rem'` | Any CSS length: the height of the scrolling window. |
| `overscan` | `number` | `4` | Rows drawn beyond the edges of the window. |
| `label (required)` | `string` |  | Names the list for screen readers. |
| `empty` | `string` |  | Message when there are no items. |

Slots: `item`.

## Usage

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref } from 'vue'
import Button from '@/components/ui/button.vue'
import VirtualList from '@/components/ui/virtual-list.vue'

const emails = Array.from({ length: 20000 }, (_, i) => ({
  id: i,
  from: ['Ada', 'Linus', 'Grace', 'Alan', 'Margaret'][i % 5]!,
  subject: `Message ${i + 1}: ${['Quarterly numbers', 'Lunch?', 'Re: the release', 'Heads up', 'Invoice attached'][i % 5]}`,
}))
// Rows of different heights are measured as they appear.
const notes = Array.from({ length: 3000 }, (_, i) => ({
  id: i,
  text: `Note ${i + 1}. ${'A longer note wraps onto more lines and the list keeps up. '.repeat(1 + ((i * 7) % 4))}`,
}))
const list = ref<{ scrollToIndex: (index: number) => void }>()
</script>

<template>
  <div class="grid gap-8 md:grid-cols-2">
    <div class="grid content-start gap-2">
      <p class="kicker">20,000 rows, a fixed height each</p>
      <VirtualList ref="list" :items="emails" :item-height="52" height="20rem" label="Mailbox">
        <template #item="{ item, index }">
          <div class="flex h-full items-center gap-3 px-4">
            <span class="numeral w-14 text-sm text-muted">{{ index + 1 }}</span>
            <span class="min-w-0 flex-1 truncate"><span class="font-medium">{{ item.from }}</span> {{ item.subject }}</span>
          </div>
        </template>
      </VirtualList>
      <div class="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3">
        <Button @click="list?.scrollToIndex(12345)">Jump to 12,346</Button>
        <p class="text-muted">Focus it for arrows, Page Up and Down, Home and End.</p>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="grid content-start gap-2">
      <p class="kicker">3,000 rows, heights measured as they appear</p>
      <VirtualList :items="notes" height="20rem" label="Notes">
        <template #item="{ item }"><p class="px-4 py-3 leading-normal">{{ item.text }}</p></template>
      </VirtualList>
    </div>
  </div>
</template>
```

## Rules

- Style it through theme tokens, not classes: sui has one design per component and no variants. `tone` exists only on status components.
- You own the copy: edit the file if the design must change.


---

# Data table

A quiet captioned table for any data. Opt in to sort, search, filters, resizing, a column menu, selection and paging; also server mode, windowing and cards on narrow screens.

Group: Data. Registry item: http://localhost:5173/r/data-table.json

## Install

```sh
bunx shadcn-vue@latest add http://localhost:5173/r/data-table.json
```

Installs with: theme, utils, pagination, popover, checkbox, button, announce. npm packages: none beyond Vue.

Import it from your own copy: `import Datatable from '@/components/ui/data-table.vue'`.

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `v-model:selected` | `(string \| number)[]` | `[]` | Two-way bound value. |
| `v-model:page` | `number` | `1` | Two-way bound value. |
| `columns (required)` | `Column[]` |  |  |
| `rows (required)` | `Row[]` |  |  |
| `selectable` | `boolean` |  |  |
| `pageSize` | `number` |  |  |
| `rowKey` | `string` |  | Field that identifies a row in `selected`. Defaults to the row's position in `rows`. |
| `label` | `string` | `'Data table'` | The table's name for screen readers: it is the table's caption, hidden unless `showCaption`. |
| `showCaption` | `boolean` |  |  |
| `empty` | `string` |  | Message when there are no rows. The `empty` slot replaces it. |
| `searchable` | `boolean` |  | A search box above the table that matches any column. |
| `searchDebounce` | `number` | `200` |  |
| `resizable` | `boolean` |  | Column resizing: drag the edge, or focus it and use the arrow keys (Shift for bigger steps, Home resets, Esc cancels). |
| `columnMenu` | `boolean` |  | A Columns menu to show and hide columns. |
| `stickyFirst` | `boolean` |  | Keeps the first column in view while the table scrolls sideways. |
| `maxHeight` | `string` |  | Any CSS length. The table scrolls inside it and its header stays in view. |
| `dense` | `boolean` |  |  |
| `striped` | `boolean` |  |  |
| `cards` | `boolean` |  | Below a medium container width every row becomes a card with the column labels beside the values. |
| `manual` | `boolean` |  | Server mode: the table does not sort, filter or page itself. It emits `queryChange` and shows what `rows` and `total` say. |
| `total` | `number` |  |  |
| `loading` | `boolean` |  |  |
| `error` | `string` |  |  |
| `rowLabel` | `string \| ((row: Row) => string)` |  | Names a row's checkbox: a column key, or a function. Defaults to the first column. |
| `virtual` | `number` |  | Turns on windowing once there are more rows than this. Rows are `rowHeight` tall. |
| `rowHeight` | `number` |  |  |

Events: `queryChange`, `retry`.

Slots: ``cell-${c.key}``, `empty`.

## Usage

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref } from 'vue'
import Badge from '@/components/ui/badge.vue'
import Button from '@/components/ui/button.vue'
import DataTable from '@/components/ui/data-table.vue'

const names = ['Ada', 'Zoë', 'Grace', 'Alan', 'Margaret', 'Dennis', 'Barbara', 'Ken', 'Radia', 'Guido', 'Hedy', 'Tim', 'José', 'Édith']
const roles = ['Maintainer', 'Contributor', 'Reviewer']
const rows = names.map((name, i) => ({
  id: name.toLowerCase(),
  name,
  role: roles[i % 3]!,
  commits: 40 + ((i * 97) % 380),
  joined: new Date(2019 + (i % 6), (i * 5) % 12, 1 + ((i * 7) % 27)),
  spend: 120 + ((i * 731) % 9000) + 0.5,
}))
const columns = [
  { key: 'name', label: 'Name', sortable: true, filter: 'text' as const },
  { key: 'role', label: 'Role', sortable: true, filter: 'select' as const },
  { key: 'commits', label: 'Commits', sortable: true, filter: 'number' as const, format: 'number' as const },
  { key: 'joined', label: 'Joined', sortable: true, format: 'date' as const },
  { key: 'spend', label: 'Spend', sortable: true, format: 'currency' as const },
]
const plainColumns = columns.map(({ key, label, format }) => ({ key, label, format }))
const selected = ref<(string | number)[]>(['grace'])

const invoices = [
  { number: 'INV-1042', customer: 'Northwind', total: 1280 },
  { number: 'INV-1043', customer: 'Contoso', total: 460 },
  { number: 'INV-1044', customer: 'Fabrikam', total: 3120 },
]
const invoiceColumns = [
  { key: 'number', label: 'Invoice' },
  { key: 'customer', label: 'Customer', sortable: true },
  { key: 'total', label: 'Total (USD)', sortable: true, align: 'end' as const },
]

// A custom cell: the status is shown as a Badge but sorts and filters on its text.
const tasks = [
  { id: 1, task: 'Ship the registry', status: 'Done', due: 3 },
  { id: 2, task: 'Write the docs', status: 'Active', due: 9 },
  { id: 3, task: 'Fix the focus ring', status: 'Blocked', due: 2 },
  { id: 4, task: 'Tidy the theme', status: 'Active', due: 14 },
]
const taskColumns = [
  { key: 'task', label: 'Task', sortable: true },
  { key: 'status', label: 'Status', sortable: true },
  { key: 'due', label: 'Due', sortable: true, align: 'end' as const, format: (v: unknown) => `in ${v} days` },
]
const tone = { Done: 'success', Active: 'info', Blocked: 'danger' } as const

// Wide table: sticky first column and a short window
const wide = Array.from({ length: 14 }, (_, i) => ({
  id: i,
  region: ['North', 'South', 'East', 'West'][i % 4]!,
  q1: 120 + i * 17,
  q2: 140 + i * 11,
  q3: 90 + i * 23,
  q4: 160 + i * 9,
  total: 510 + i * 60,
}))
const wideColumns = [
  { key: 'region', label: 'Region', width: 160 },
  ...['q1', 'q2', 'q3', 'q4', 'total'].map((k) => ({ key: k, label: k.toUpperCase(), width: 140, sortable: true })),
]

// Server mode: the table asks, we answer later
const everyone = Array.from({ length: 87 }, (_, i) => ({ id: i + 1, user: `user-${String(i + 1).padStart(3, '0')}`, plan: ['Free', 'Team', 'Scale'][i % 3]!, seats: 1 + (i % 9) }))
const serverRows = ref<typeof everyone>([])
const serverTotal = ref(everyone.length)
const loading = ref(true)
const failing = ref(false)
const last = ref('nothing yet')
let lastQuery: { sort: { key: string; dir: string } | null; search: string; page: number } = { sort: null, search: '', page: 1 }
function load(q = lastQuery) {
  lastQuery = q
  loading.value = true
  failing.value = false
  last.value = `page ${q.page}${q.sort ? `, sorted by ${q.sort.key} ${q.sort.dir}` : ''}${q.search ? `, search “${q.search}”` : ''}`
  setTimeout(() => {
    loading.value = false
    if (broken.value) return (failing.value = true)
    let list = everyone.filter((r) => !q.search || r.user.includes(q.search.toLowerCase()))
    if (q.sort) {
      const { key, dir } = q.sort
      list = [...list].sort((a, b) => String(a[key as 'user']).localeCompare(String(b[key as 'user']), undefined, { numeric: true }) * (dir === 'asc' ? 1 : -1))
    }
    serverTotal.value = list.length
    serverRows.value = list.slice((q.page - 1) * 8, q.page * 8)
  }, 700)
}
load()
const broken = ref(false)
const serverColumns = [
  { key: 'id', label: 'ID', sortable: true },
  { key: 'user', label: 'User', sortable: true },
  { key: 'plan', label: 'Plan' },
  { key: 'seats', label: 'Seats', sortable: true },
]

// Windowing: 5000 rows, only those in view exist in the page
const big = Array.from({ length: 5000 }, (_, i) => ({ id: i, event: `evt_${String(i).padStart(5, '0')}`, kind: ['click', 'view', 'submit'][i % 3]!, ms: 20 + ((i * 37) % 900) }))
const bigColumns = [
  { key: 'event', label: 'Event' },
  { key: 'kind', label: 'Kind', sortable: true },
  { key: 'ms', label: 'Duration (ms)', sortable: true },
]
</script>

<template>
  <div class="grid gap-10">
    <div class="grid gap-2">
      <p class="kicker">Everything on · {{ selected.length }} selected</p>
      <DataTable
        v-model:selected="selected"
        label="Team"
        :columns="columns"
        :rows="rows"
        row-key="id"
        selectable
        searchable
        resizable
        column-menu
        :page-size="6"
        row-label="name"
      />
      <p class="text-muted">Search “jose” finds José: matching ignores case and accents.</p>
    </div>

    <div class="grid gap-8 md:grid-cols-2">
      <div class="grid content-start gap-2">
        <p class="kicker">Static: it is just a quiet table</p>
        <DataTable label="Invoices" show-caption :columns="invoiceColumns" :rows="invoices" />
      </div>
      <div class="grid content-start gap-2">
        <p class="kicker">Dense, striped, custom cell</p>
        <DataTable label="Tasks" :columns="taskColumns" :rows="tasks" dense striped>
          <template #cell-status="{ value }"><Badge :tone="tone[value as keyof typeof tone]">{{ value }}</Badge></template>
        </DataTable>
      </div>
      <div class="grid content-start gap-2">
        <p class="kicker">Empty</p>
        <DataTable label="Invoices" :columns="invoiceColumns" :rows="[]" empty="No invoices yet." />
      </div>
      <div class="grid content-start gap-2">
        <p class="kicker">Cards on a narrow container</p>
        <DataTable label="Team" :columns="plainColumns" :rows="rows.slice(0, 2)" cards class="max-w-xs" />
      </div>
    </div>

    <div class="grid gap-2">
      <p class="kicker">Sticky header and first column</p>
      <DataTable label="Regions" :columns="wideColumns" :rows="wide" row-key="id" sticky-first max-height="14rem" striped class="max-w-xl" />
    </div>

    <div class="grid gap-2">
      <div class="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3">
        <p class="kicker">Server mode · last request: {{ last }}</p>
        <Button @click="((broken = !broken), load())">{{ broken ? 'Make it work' : 'Make it fail' }}</Button>
      </div>
      <DataTable
        label="Users"
        :columns="serverColumns"
        :rows="serverRows"
        :total="serverTotal"
        :page-size="8"
        manual
        searchable
        :loading="loading"
        :error="failing ? 'We could not load the users.' : undefined"
        @query-change="load"
        @retry="load()"
      />
    </div>

    <div class="grid gap-2">
      <p class="kicker">Windowing: 5,000 rows, a few dozen in the page</p>
      <DataTable label="Events" :columns="bigColumns" :rows="big" :virtual="100" max-height="16rem" dense row-key="id" class="max-w-xl" />
    </div>
  </div>
</template>
```

## Rules

- Style it through theme tokens, not classes: sui has one design per component and no variants. `tone` exists only on status components.
- You own the copy: edit the file if the design must change.


---

# Resizable

Split panes with a draggable handle.

Group: Data. Registry item: http://localhost:5173/r/resizable.json

## Install

```sh
bunx shadcn-vue@latest add http://localhost:5173/r/resizable.json
```

Installs with: theme, utils. npm packages: reka-ui.

Import it from your own copy: `import Resizable from '@/components/ui/resizable.vue'`.

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `direction` | `'horizontal' \| 'vertical'` | `'horizontal'` |  |
| `sizes` | `[number, number]` | `[50, 50]` |  |
| `minSize` | `number` | `15` |  |

Events: `resize`.

Slots: `panel-a`, `panel-b`.

## Usage

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref } from 'vue'
import NavList from '@/components/ui/nav-list.vue'
import Resizable from '@/components/ui/resizable.vue'

const file = ref('button.vue')
const sections = [
  { title: 'Files', items: [{ value: 'button.vue', label: 'button.vue' }, { value: 'dialog.vue', label: 'dialog.vue' }, { value: 'tabs.vue', label: 'tabs.vue' }] },
]
</script>

<template>
  <div class="grid gap-8">
    <div class="grid gap-2">
      <p class="kicker">An editor: files, code and a console</p>
      <Resizable :sizes="[28, 72]" :min-size="15" class="h-80 max-w-3xl">
        <template #panel-a><NavList v-model="file" :sections="sections" label="Files" /></template>
        <template #panel-b>
          <Resizable direction="vertical" :sizes="[65, 35]" :min-size="20" class="h-full">
            <template #panel-a>
              <pre class="numeral p-4 text-sm leading-relaxed text-ink">// {{ file }}
export const label = 'sui'
export const depth = 2</pre>
            </template>
            <template #panel-b>
              <p class="numeral p-4 text-sm leading-relaxed text-muted">✓ typecheck passed<br />✓ lint passed</p>
            </template>
          </Resizable>
        </template>
      </Resizable>
    </div>
  </div>
</template>
```

## Rules

- Style it through theme tokens, not classes: sui has one design per component and no variants. `tone` exists only on status components.
- You own the copy: edit the file if the design must change.
